meta.author: 此位置待支持，需要每名编辑者能提供自己用户名

records.idCN: 系统/系统单位(勿删勿改)
records.name: System
Katas

FoodList.letter: Born from the eternal flames, the Feast of the Abyss is bestowed upon you, Lord of Black Iron —

records.birthdayMessage: Lord of Black Iron! This is the rite of the abyss that takes dozens of moon phases to form! Have a taste!

ResumeList.des: A mysterious girl from the Empire of Abyss, carrying the Spellblade Umbral Fulgor (that is an axe no matter how you look at it). Locked in battle against the endless forces of dawn. The journey ahead will lead to the ultimate battle to destroy the old world! — If Katas were the main character of an adventure comic, the above would most likely be its synopsis, though it's all because of her insistent request. Each of her appearances is like a comic character coming to life, though reality can't craft a ring of focus lines around her to emphasize the effect... Nay, given her adventure spirit, she'd find a way to make even more impactful entrance in no time.

records.getCharacter: I am Jumakenki Katas!! Harbinger of eternal doom brought by the abyssal corruption! ...Good, that was good.

records.name: Julian

FoodList.letter: No matter how busy you are, you need to eat well. I whipped this up. Eat it while it's still hot.

records.birthdayMessage: Other than Carmine May's chocolates, I love chocolate cakes like this too. Let's share it.

ResumeList.des: BCRL Team Ratel's vice-captain, responsible for part of the command and negotiation duties. She has a very calm demeanor, assumes the role of pouring cold water on others during negotiations and combat. Appears to be the most reliable person in Team Ratel, at least on the surface. During missions, she's the first to assess the overall situation, making her a good deputy to Captain Shizuru, and tempers the two crew members' enthusiasm and affection. Skilful, fast runner, and probably a hard hitter, but seems to prefer guns.

records.getCharacter: Julian. Good at attacking, not defending. Leave the attack to me.

records.name: Margiela

FoodList.letter: Made by a witch, improper consumption may cause deformities~ Just kidding!

records.birthdayMessage: It may not look like much, but it's a cake that comes with the witch's blessing. As for its actual effect... you can experience it yourself after tasting it, Dear Conductor!

ResumeList.des: Margiela runs a cosplay costume store. Although it is a small operation, it provides thoughtful service with attention to detail and custom products that earned it a good reputation and loyal customer base. As a Night Chains member, she would close the shop if she's needed for a mission. Margiela's true passion lies in cosplay, particularly dressing up as a little witch from an animation.

records.getCharacter: I'm Margiela, manager of a cosplay costume shop. Nice to meet you.

records.name: Livia

FoodList.letter: You've worked hard, Conductor. Please stay lively for the journey ahead.

records.birthdayMessage: It's my greatest joy to board the Eternal with you. Looking forward to another great year ahead, Conductor!

ResumeList.des: Conductor's assistant. Livia suffered critical injuries in an accident many years ago and was rescued by Signora Medici, head of COLUMBA. Upon regaining consciousness, Livia had lost most of her memories, other than the Mundus Empire being her birth place. To repay Signora Medici, Livia joined COLUMBA after passing the crew exam and, by pure chance, teamed up once again with her training school classmate — Conductor.

records.getCharacter: We've already been through so much together, but the road ahead is still long... Let's go. I'll be by your side, Conductor.

records.name: Connor

FoodList.letter: The food on the surface is really good. Want to try this?

records.birthdayMessage: The culinary skills aboveground are way more advanced... How I wish my old buddies could taste this too. But now isn't the time to talk about this. After having this cake, I'll take you out for a ride!

ResumeList.des: Connor is Livia's old acquaintance. According to both her and Livia, she was once an Empire soldier. She stands out among mercenaries with her outstanding skills and valiant bearing, and has earned a good reputation. Her chivalric demeanor makes it easy for people to trust her, and many Imperials with mercenary experience on the surface have been under her care. After encountering many experiences, Connor has had one thing in mind. How should she change for the happiness of those important to her?

records.getCharacter: Former Mundus Empire's soldier, Connor. Working as a bodyguard now for some reason. Pleased to meet you.

records.name: Tara

FoodList.letter: Cook has also helped a bit, but most of the credit goes to Tara!

records.birthdayMessage: Cook says it would rather have grilled chicken skewers, but based on tradition, it's better to order a cake... We'll be back in a bit!

ResumeList.des: After experiencing a series of unexpected events with the adventure team, the girl decided to join them. She travels with a large eagle-like bird named Cook. With simple attire and a petite frame, she appears relaxed and carefree. Hailing from the Mundus Empire, she seems to have no bias against the surface world and is interested in sceneries. She's a tiny traveler in search of someone. Her current goal in life is to find her father, who left home for years, and give him a good beating.

records.getCharacter: I'm Tara, and this is Cook.

records.name: Solum

FoodList.letter: Made under my sister's guidance. Reminds me of home.

records.birthdayMessage: My sister likes this! — My brother too.

ResumeList.des: People often use the word "disharmony" to describe Solum because "she" is strange in many ways: While Solum has a feminine body and a young girl's voice, her mannerisms and tone are unlike that of a "young girl". If you underestimate this guard because of her petite stature, you would suffer — Hmm, perhaps it's a disguise to confuse enemies?

records.getCharacter: I'm Solum. Due to some reasons, I can only move through my sister's body now. Nice to meet you!

records.name: Maruha

FoodList.letter: After finishing this special meal, let's fight evil together~

records.birthdayMessage: Don't you find the color of cut strawberries captivating? I hope you'll understand the charm of such a color as well.

ResumeList.des: As a waitress at the Night Chains Hotel, Maruha's friendly smile leaves a deep impression on everyone. Although she makes occasional clumsy mistakes, her friendly attitude allows her to maintain good relationships with colleagues and guests. However, if she were just a friendly and gentle waitress, how could Maruha establish herself in an organization like Night Chains? There seems to be something hidden behind that smile...

records.getCharacter: I'm Maruha. I'll chase away all the bad guys.

records.name: Cecil

FoodList.letter: Overpowering flavors can damage the sense of smell, so I prefer this kind of bland food.

records.birthdayMessage: Cakes like this taste refreshing and free from impurities. They're ideal for people who don't want their taste buds affected... But take care not to eat too much. I brought mouthwash; remember to use it.

ResumeList.des: As a calm and firm researcher, Cecil has a innately acute sense of smell and a great interest in studying scents since young. After joining Night Chains, her research has achieved considerable success. While it isn't tough to approach Cecil, you'll definitely face her disdain if you've come into contact with something pungent. Long-time Night Chains members also agree: when Cecil shows particular interest and closeness to someone, that person should be on guard.

records.getCharacter: I'm Cecil, a scent researcher... I don't hate your scent. Nice to meet you.

records.name: Reika

FoodList.letter: It's a blessing to even have food. Don't be picky about how it looks. Eat up!

records.birthdayMessage: It's for you. If you ever see such a cake outside, do not eat it, or at least let me inspect it first. It might just have something dangerous concealed within!

ResumeList.des: BCRL Team Meerkat's demolitions expert, a sharp-tongued loner. While Reika's skills and precision in demolitions score full marks, her interpersonal skills and teamwork are unfortunately in the negatives. Even if you've known her for a long time, you might suddenly wonder if she ever intended to get along with you. Since none of her current teammates is overly outgoing, Reika is quite satisfied with the status quo.

records.getCharacter: I'm Reika. I prefer to be alone off-work. Don't ever talk to me!

records.name: Desiree

FoodList.letter: Here! A gift for you, Conductor! Definitely delicious!

records.birthdayMessage: I bought the most super duper pretty cake, and it barely even cost anything! You got to eat it with me, Conductor!

ResumeList.des: A guard crew member under a long-term contract with COLUMBA. Desiree is spirited and always brings joy with her innocent remarks. However, once she enters combat, her ruthless and precise archery instills fear. Her marksmanship can almost be described as unfailingly accurate. The stark contrast between her youthful appearance and her proficient use of Ascension Ability, which are nearly on par with BCRL veterans with at least five years, hints at an extraordinary past.

records.getCharacter: I'm Desiree! My dream is to be a pure and lovely girl who can smile wherever I go! Nice to meet you!

records.name: Charlotte

FoodList.letter: This dessert might not look as yummy as the ones Tistar made, but it should still fill the stomach. Try it.

records.birthdayMessage: Enjoy this exclusive Knight's Hall cake! Even though the only thing I did was decorate it with cherries, a store-bought cake should taste all right, I guess...?

ResumeList.des: Charlotte, who single-handedly founded the Knight's Hall, not only comes from a noble family but was also a soldier. As a result, she has impeccable swordsmanship, aesthetics, and etiquette. Charlotte is known for her gentle and courteous demeanor, as well as her eager and responsible attitude. Everyone knows that if they need help, they can count on her. In addition to accepting security assignments, the Knight's Hall also offers swordsmanship training. Due to the professional security and reasonable prices, it is popular among the commoners.

records.getCharacter: Hello, I'm Charlotte, currently managing the "Knight's Hall" on the surface. Nice to meet you.

records.name: Aoba

FoodList.letter: Cooking isn't my thing... Hope this is at least edible...

records.birthdayMessage: ...I ordered you a cake when I went to get Yoizuki one. Take it as appreciation for your usual kindness.

ResumeList.des: A bodyguard from Night Chains. She isn't armed and doesn't usually ride the train alone. Aoba is quiet and doesn't interact much with others on the train. Her sole duty is to protect her younger sister, Yoizuki, the future head of Mugenryu. A more Night Chains-style codename for Aoba would be "Shadow Dancer of Yoizuki". She obeys her sister's orders without question. Standing alone in the shadows, Aoba is like a shade unwilling to exist.

records.getCharacter: I am Aoba. I only follow Yoizuki's orders.

records.name: Eliot

FoodList.letter: Added freshly baked chicken to the curry. It tastes really good~

records.birthdayMessage: Naturally, birthdays can't be spent without sharing a cake with everybody! Let's have a party tonight, Conductor!

ResumeList.des: A guard crew member under a long-term contract with COLUMBA, currently stationed on the Eternal, and has a good relationship with Fran. Although she usually seems lazy, her observation and sensitivity are exceptionally keen, always sensing danger early. She's an excellent hunter, so you'd better be careful if targeted by her crossbow. At critical moments, Eliot becomes serious and is an indispensable help.

records.getCharacter: I'm Eliot. I'll do what needs to be done.

records.name: Lissandra

FoodList.letter: Pay no mind to the passing whims of your taste buds. Make sure your body gets the nutrition it needs: that is what truly counts.

records.birthdayMessage: I purchased this gift from a dessert shop in a Bonfire City. While it may not fully convey my feelings for you, it is a lovely treat to share among friends.

ResumeList.des: As a Vanguard (honorary) of the Destroyer at Source Citadel, Lissandra is a mentor and predecessor to many members within the Destroyer and other Citadel departments, with her age undisclosed. Sporting a perennially dependable smile, she holds strong beliefs and excels in philosophical contemplation and debate. Notably, she is renowned for engaging in a three-day discourse with a peer mentor of equivalent standing. While she is a trustworthy ally in times of peril, it is advised to steer clear of deep philosophical discussions on topics like humanity, society, and life with Lissandra, as those who have attempted this have learned their lessons the hard way.

records.getCharacter: I am Lissandra. Be it light or darkness, as long as your belief is firm, I shall eventually reach your side.

records.name: Yoizuki

FoodList.letter: I chose a dessert that tastes like "Rakugan." I wonder if you'll like it, Conductor?

records.birthdayMessage: Seems like someone bought it and had it sent here, but I still prefer the taste of Rakugan... So, you can have it. Hope you'll like it.

ResumeList.des: Yoizuki is the next head of Mugenryu, and is also the overall person-in-charge of Night Chains Lesage. Her mere presence is as beautiful as a blooming night cherry tree, causing other passengers on The Eternal to mistake that they boarded the wrong train. She is kind and skilled in communication and negotiation, showing no airs of a family head, always wearing a gentle, proper smile on her face. Whether the train is attacked or receives sudden unknown communications, she handles it all with unmoving grace with no hint of fear. Additionally, the crew's manifest lists a bodyguard, who occasionally appears beside her like a shadow.

records.getCharacter: I'm Yoizuki of Night Chains. I look forward to working with you in the future.

records.name: Ilona

FoodList.letter: These are the only materials left in the carriage. I didn't want to go out, so I made do with them.

records.birthdayMessage: They all threw a birthday party for me. I said I didn't want to go, but they still dragged me there... It's honestly not too bad going once in a blue moon, though. Here, have some cake...

ResumeList.des: A sniper from the BCRL Team Meerkat, a well-known recluse whose motto is to never stepping outside unless absolutely necessary. Ilona frequently misses lively group events and often disappears during missions, with team members saying she hides in a concealed spot. Fortunately, her shooting skills are excellent, and she has various means of providing support to ensure she isn't forgotten. When BCRL members and other train passengers mention her, they always ask, "Did she go out today?"

records.getCharacter: Ilona, Team Meerkat... Sniper, hmm...

records.name: Shizuru

FoodList.letter: Tastes the same as before. I hope you still like it.

records.birthdayMessage: During high school, we could never afford such cakes sold in the commercial street cafés, but now, I can finally buy them with my salary at any time. Consider this my treat.

ResumeList.des: Young but capable captain of BCRL Team Ratel. Although her overall abilities are not as good as other Team Ratel members, her quick reflexes, grasp of command, and tactical planning make her a convincing leader. The Conductor's friend for many years, although their communication has mostly been limited to long-distance.

records.getCharacter: I'm Shizuru. Nice to meet you... No way, I didn't expect to meet you again at such a place.

records.name: Arcana

FoodList.letter: Attempted recreation of a traditional Empire dessert, a flavor kids would like.

records.birthdayMessage: Though I have long forgot the exact date... yet I bear in mind I drew breath when spring returneth to the earth. This day I am at leisure, so I baked a cake after the fashion of the Empire, and wove a touch of magic therein for adornment.

ResumeList.des: Leader of the little adventure party, a girl who takes on leadership responsibility, but seems the youngest among the group, looking only twelve or thirteen. She speaks in an unusually mature tone and carries herself like an experienced traveler and has the unquestioned trust of her party members. She always wears a fluffy white outfit regardless of the season, and somehow it neither gets dirty nor needs frequent changing. Sometimes, Arcana speaks in the tone reminiscent of an elderly, perhaps as a result of the strong influence of her elders?

records.getCharacter: My name is Arcana. Just a traveler you find anywhere.

records.name: Galina

ResumeList.des:
小时候加丽娜曾为了保护妹妹达莉娅身受重伤，因此昏睡了数年。

等她再度醒来时，因为漫长岁月的记忆缺失陷入了不安与混乱。

虽然她好不容易振作，鼓起勇气去面对这一切，却还是因为后遗症在语言交流上出现困难。

因为这一点她变得羞于交流，也不敢向他人打开心扉，给了人沉默冷静的错误印象。实际上因为精神年龄，加丽娜的思想还非常稚嫩和单纯，心理活动也很丰富。

除了妹妹和带自己来到学会的卡塔斯，其他人都难以得到加丽娜的信任。现在的她也在不断努力去适应现在的自己。

records.getCharacter: Hello, I am Galina. My sister and I were under your care before, so... it's been a while.

records.name: Fran

FoodList.letter: This should restore your strength. Eat up, don't be a stranger.

records.birthdayMessage: If I'm not wrong, I'm not the only birthday girl today... Let's get everyone together for a meal. I'll do the cooking.

ResumeList.des: A guard crew member under a long-term contract with COLUMBA, currently stationed on the Eternal, and has a good relationship with Eliot. Fran is a shield bearer at the front line, appearing steady and reliable in combat. She is well-balanced in all aspects, both physically and mentally resilient. Filled with a strong sense of responsibility, she always leads the charge and protects teammates with her shield. Her back is a reassuring sight for her companions.

records.getCharacter: I'm Fran, pleased to meet you, Conductor. By the way, where's Eliot?

records.name: Nayuta

FoodList.letter: ...Sommer and Mr. Dustin liked it. Here's some for you.

records.birthdayMessage: ...I didn't expect the best-seller in Bonfire City to be this—completely different from the usual cake styles at the Citadel... Still, I hope you like it.

ResumeList.des: Enigmatic visitor from the Source Citadel, a young man of few words. His whereabouts are a mystery, and his actions seem different from most of the Citadel members. Nayuta values efficiency and secrecy, and always operates alone. Through observing his daily life, it's apparent that he shares a close, almost familial relationship with Dustin and Sommer from Source Citadel. According to BOX's combat data analysis, Nayuta's tactics against human enemies are more sophisticated than those for dealing with Chaos Remains...

records.getCharacter: I'm Nayuta. As a member of the Source Citadel, I'm here to bring you hope and light... hm, that's not really something I can actually do. In any case, I look forward to working with you.

records.name: Sommer

FoodList.letter: I tried... my best... Hope you'll accept it...

records.birthdayMessage: I... tried decorating... the cake... How does it look?

ResumeList.des: A member of the Destroyer, Source Citadel. She awakened her Ascension Ability at a young age. However, due to its unstable nature, she faced the risk of becoming a Deep Sleeper. Thanks to timely treatment by the Citadel, her condition was stabilized. However, her mutant left hand remains unhealed. Currently, she serves as a frontline combatant and shares a familial relationship with Dustin and Nayuta, who are also members of the Destroyer.

records.getCharacter: I'm... Sommer... I'll... try my best...

records.name: Dorothy

FoodList.letter: Feel the burst of juicy meat in your mouth! Note: it doesn't actually burst.

records.birthdayMessage: I sprinkled several packets of different flavored popping candy on the cake! Don't worry. I absolutely will not conduct any explosive oral experiment.☆

ResumeList.des: Dorothy is a BCRL Team Ratel member, serving as the demolition expert. Her fiery and boisterous personality is a perfect match for her role. Her laughter and voice can usually be heard from a carriage away. Be it at work or in daily life, she's a lively girl who keeps everyone on their toes. If you bump into her out in the field with a detonator switch in hand, duck immediately when she takes action, to avoid being caught in the blast.

records.getCharacter: Yahoo~~! I'm Dorothy! I'll be counting on you from now on!

records.name: Galore

FoodList.letter: When I was cooking, the pets were attracted and almost ate sum... Don't worry. I didn't let them eat it.

records.birthdayMessage: I requested the dessert shop to use ingredients with low sugar. If possible, please share some with the animals onboard.

ResumeList.des: Flamingo Petshop is well-regarded among pet lovers in Shoggolith City. The owner, Galore, is known for his gentle and meticulous care of pets. It might be hard to imagine such kindness and patience existing under his cold and gloomy exterior, but he has undoubtedly earned praise from customers and trust from animals. Occasionally, Galore would suddenly showcase his magic tricks. Though judging from his level of expertise, it's clear that magic is more than just a hobby for him. Galore avoids communication as much as possible and rarely talks about himself.  However, his calmness and efficiency indicate he has the combat experience to handle any unexpected situations.

records.getCharacter: I'm Galore. If you see "flamingo", you must let me know... No, not the kind with the color of my hair...

records.name: Karen

FoodList.letter: Just learned this new recipe. I want to make it for Shizuru next time. This is a test~ So remember to give feedback!

records.birthdayMessage: This cake—I bought it specially to share with you, you know. See? There's room in here for someone other than Shizuru after all~

ResumeList.des: A member of Team Ratel under BCRL. Karen comes from a wealthy merchant family, and though she's toughened up quite a bit since training camp, there's still a trace of that high-society air in the way she talks—something everyone around her has long since gotten used to, and no one holds it against her or treats her as some kind of untouchable young lady. It was her admiration for Shizuru, and her determination to follow in her footsteps, that led Karen to enroll at the BCRL training camp in the first place, and she genuinely worked hard enough to make it through. These days, if there's anything at all that could trouble a young lady who otherwise finds most things beneath her notice, it's probably just this: how to get a little closer to Shizuru.

records.getCharacter: Good day to you, Your Conductor-ship. I'm Karen. Nice to meet you.

records.name: Reeva

FoodList.letter: Such food is rather amazing. Although it comes with vegetables, meat is the main ingredient. Delicious.

records.birthdayMessage: The cherries in it remind me of fresh blood... But I like this sweetness more. I'll give you the slice with the most filling.

ResumeList.des: Reeva, a "Devil Hunter" from the Mundus Empire, is currently taking on various "devil hunting" commissions in Bonfire Cities across the Western Continent Railway Loop. Whether it is an unknown creature discovered inside or outside the city, or an unexplained anomaly found within a residence, it seems to fall within the scope of this Devil Hunter's services. As long as the client can provide a specific location of the incident, Reeva will go there to track it down and deal with it. With such extraordinary abilities, she should, in theory, be able to achieve great things from a much higher position. However...

records.getCharacter: I'm a "Devil Hunter." I saw an order from the Eternal... There aren't any devils on the train that need catching? Then just think of me as an ordinary passenger.

records.name: Stella

FoodList.letter: Made with the best ratio! Remember to give me feedback to improve after you've tried it, okay?

records.birthdayMessage: I'll order a nicer galaxy mirror cake next year. For now, just treat this as my gift of appreciation!
records.basic: A crystal mining expert currently stationed in COLUMBA on cooperative terms to provide scientific and logistical support.

ResumeList.des: An Anita researcher studying Chaos Crystals. Stella had her independent lab at a young age. She is always full of energy, and is a young girl with aspirations. Occasionally boarding the Eternal while entering and exiting the Chaos Space and exploring new areas, she exudes an aura of perfection like a pampered girl refined down to every strand of hair. However, just like how beautifully maintained long hair requires a lot of care, Stella's life hasn't been smooth-sailing — though this might need time with her to comprehend fully.

records.getCharacter: You're the Conductor? You don't look very reliable... Oh well. My name is Stella. Pleased to meet you.

records.name: Rachel

FoodList.letter: I used my latest super delicious and non-toxic formula in the jam~

records.birthdayMessage: I accidentally added several new flavoring reagents. It tastes ultra-rich now!

ResumeList.des: As a BCRL researcher, Rachel is not required to engage in combat. However, to obtain firsthand data and improve her development of the supply reagent kit "Rainbow Flask," she applied to join Team Meerkat. By working with Team Meerkat, which primarily handles support and special missions, Rachel was able to conduct experiments and collect data on the battlefield. Rachel's research is progressing well juding from the new colors she has developed for the "Rainbow Flask."

records.getCharacter: Hello there, Conductor. I'm a BCRL researcher responsible for R&D... Oh right, my name! I'm Rachel. Nice to meet you~

records.name: Fenia

FoodList.letter: It's said this is a dessert mature ladies excel at! Please try it, Conductor!

records.birthdayMessage: I tried going with the flavor that's said to be enjoyed by mature ladies! But I still think ice cream tastes better...

ResumeList.des: Fenia's parents are Citadel scholars, making the Citadel's libraries and the giant airship Senanonic her hometown. As her parents hoped, Fenia became an Ascender early on and was exceptionally talented. Growing up in the Citadel, she has the purest love for humanity and an undeniable hostility toward Chaos Remains. To achieve the goal of annihilating all Chaos Remains and protecting the world, Fenia joined the Destroyer and took the initiative to venture into the battlefield.

records.getCharacter: I'm Fenia! Charging in for world peace!

records.name: Valentine

FoodList.letter: I love this snack. It can be slowly savored while reading.

records.birthdayMessage: I adjusted the cake recipe according to the book and lessened the amount of sugar used... Shall we try the fruit of my labor together?

ResumeList.des: Valentine is one of the Citadel's scribes, responsible for cataloguing books in the Fabricate, essentially a librarian — She has an almost photographic memory when it comes to books, making her a walking book retrieval system. Whenever a visitor needs a book, she can find it quickly. She has also created a mini-library within the sea of academic books, specifically for books not included in the Fabricate.

records.getCharacter: Hello, I'm Valentine. I serve as a scribe at the Citadel.

records.name: Achiwa

FoodList.letter: I bought this while getting fries. I can't finish it myself, so here's some for you.

records.birthdayMessage: Fast food subscription cards are way more practical than birthday cakes... But still, it's already been bought. Wanna eat it together?

ResumeList.des: Anita Energy Company intern Achiwa frequently travels between the Chaos Space and the real world for exploration and pioneering work. Her work mostly involves... rock crushing, so it seems. She carries an exploration tool resembling both a bat and a hammer, functioning as a weapon and tool. The weapon has significant explosive power and has been well-modified by its wielder. Based on the outer casing and additional components, it might also have advanced technological features — why does an intern's weapon have such latest tech? Did she pay for it herself?

records.getCharacter: Oh hello, Conductor, I'm Achiwa, a dropout with issues. Nice to meet you.

records.name: Wensheng

FoodList.letter: When you're tired, have something warm and easy to digest...

records.birthdayMessage: I bought it from the chocolaterie I frequent. Thank you for always being nice to me. I'll bring other presents in the future.

ResumeList.des: As Safety Director of Night Chains Hotel, Wensheng gives the impression of a dangerous and unapproachable person. Although the job might seem glamorous, everyone knows the shady business behind Night Chains Hotel and has the tacit understanding — "Being in post requires brains, strength, and guts." Hence, most are baffled when they see Wensheng expressionlessly playing a claw machine at a street corner store...

records.getCharacter: Wensheng, accompanying you at the behest of Mr. Sagi. Hmm. Your scent... No, don't mind me.

records.name: Rina Von

FoodList.letter: A heart traumatized by working late at night needs good food to heal!

records.birthdayMessage: "Holiday Resort" 100% additive-free customized cake, made in Gronru City. Same-day postage, paid delivery available.

ResumeList.des: It's easy for Rina Von to come across as a powerful figure, given that she works for the Citadel, well-versed in various organizations' intelligence, and can provide rare social data. However, she claims recording such information is just a hobby and discourages exaggeration of her abilities. Though not a workaholic, Rina Von is a reliable doer, always completing tasks systematically.

records.getCharacter: I'm Rina Von from the Citadel. Dispatched here to help... Um, is it true that you clock out on time here...?

records.name: Ezra

ResumeList.des:
埃兹拉从小就为了成为一名优秀的帝国骑士而不断努力，等到了合适的年龄便前往帝国首都的骑士训练营。

因为长年累月不懈锻炼出的身体素质和身为混响者的强大力量，他很快如愿被录取。

然而凡事有利有弊，普通武器不足以承担他狂放的战斗风格，损耗得相当厉害。

为寻求坚固的武器，埃兹拉暂别骑士团的同僚，最终认为求人不如求己，干脆拜师学起了武器锻造的技艺。

他做事心无旁骛，总是一门心思投入其中，因此培养出了对武器锻造的热爱，技术也是突飞猛进。

当埃兹拉见识到来自地表的武器图纸后，深深为这种闻所未闻的技术所打动，决心前往地表寻求全新的突破。

records.getCharacter: Let's be clear. Do not disturb me when I'm working, got it?

records.name: Tobinezumi

FoodList.letter: Food for Ninjas must be very portable and easy to consume. Beyond that... Here you go, Conductor.

records.birthdayMessage: I thought about how kind you have been to me when I happened to pass by a cake shop while on a mission, and so I especially purchased this cake to express my gratitude. It looks utterly delicious...

ResumeList.des: As a ninja active in the shadows, Tobinezumi knows how to hide with various guises. She excels in disguise and impersonation, playing different roles to infiltrate or gather information. Her excellent skills and unpredictable appearance mean few know this quiet, shy girl is a skilled ninja.

records.getCharacter: I'm Shiu, code name "Tobinezumi", from Genuryu. Nice to meet you!

records.name: Suen

FoodList.letter: I didn't make this specifically for you. Don't get the wrong idea!

records.birthdayMessage: This is a birthday cake gifted to you by Lady Suen! If you want to eat it together with me, you will have to beg me for it!

ResumeList.des: A girl from the Source Citadel, remembered for the strange patterns covering her body. Though she's just a child in terms of age, all test results show she has adult-like qualities, leading her to always act as an adult. Whether in the Citadel or on the train, the very friendly Suen can talk anyone's ear off. If someone shows curiosity about the patterns on her body, Suen will proudly and openly display them.

records.getCharacter: I'm Suen, a cute girl from the Citadel! You can be infatuated with me or idolize me! But! No stalking allowed!

records.name: Millie

FoodList.letter: I cooked my favorite meat patties and stuffed them in! You need meat for strength!

ResumeList.des:
米莉作为以古老优雅闻名的贵族世家小姐，偏偏对成为帝国骑士充满兴趣。她得到父母的支持来到一位老骑士手下学艺，并且在战斗方面的学习进步神速。

初次参加斗技大会的米莉完全摒弃了作为一名骑士应有的礼法，为了击败敌人不惜上嘴撕咬，这一狂犬本色惊呆了众人。

在正式出师，得到师父赠予的斧头之后没多久，米莉就为了摆脱贵族的繁文缛节前往地表。

她强烈的竞争心和莽撞热血的个性终于再也没有任何束缚，很快便依靠强大的力量和狂野的性格在各大篝火城的斗技场之间出名。

现在的米莉做着保镖的工作，别的暂且不论，论实力她还是相当受雇主信赖的。

records.getCharacter: My name is Millie! I just need to be responsible for driving away anyone who approaches you, right?!

records.idCN: 01敌方/试炼场/挨揍蝎/挨揍蝎-霸主级
records.name: Punching Scorpion: Dominant
Yamaarashi

FoodList.letter: The kitchenware on the Eternal is so hard to use. I can't make anything tasty!

records.birthdayMessage: Ninjas ought to be vigilant against any food made by others! That being said, I certainly did not stuff a shuriken in the cake.

ResumeList.des: The future inheritor of Mugenryu, hidden in the city, the pillar of the detective agency — Shiki, also known as Lord Yamaarashi! Whether honing ninja skills or detective work, she must be the best, in particular, better than her rival Tobinezumi! To this end, no matter the obstacle before her, she advances resolutely on the path of justice... Can I become an action movie star?! Why would Lord Yamaarashi want to b-become an action star?! Surpassing Tobinezumi in ninja skills is enough, and nothing else matters for the sole inheritor of Mugenryu! Forget what I said!

records.getCharacter: I'm the inheritor of Mugenryu Ninjutsu, Shiki, aka Yamaarashi. And I'm the archenemy of Tobinezumi! Ohohoho!

records.name: Box

FoodList.letter: Heated instant dessert, provides enough calories to sustain for three days.

records.birthdayMessage: This unit has received a birthday cake sent by COLUMBA. As I am incapable of ingesting human food, please eat it all on my behalf, Conductor.
records.basic: BOX (Bionic Operator X) is a multi-functional android developed by the BCRL Research Department and Anita Tech to assist humans in various technical tasks. It has many derivative models, but due to its high cost, it hasn't been widely adopted. BOX equipped on the train can assist the conductor in operating the train, temporarily taking over in special circumstances using pre-set programs.

It has many derivative models, but due to its high cost, it hasn't been widely adopted. BOX equipped on the train can assist the conductor in operating the train, temporarily taking over in special circumstances using pre-set programs.

records.getCharacter: Bionic Operator X activated. Please select the voice profile for the android dialogue system from the settings.

records.name: Punch Me MK.I
records.battleDes: A training robot assigned by the B.C.R.L. for daily training sessions with crew members on the train.
records.safeInformation: The modified Box MK.I model, only good for taking a beating.
records.unitInformation: Connected to Combat System MK.I, this Box lacks combat abilities, simply cowering behind the combat system and taking hits.

records.idCN: 01敌方/试炼场/挨揍宝2000剑/挨揍宝2000
records.name: Punch Me MK.II
records.battleDes: A state-of-the-art training robot upgraded to the latest generation by the B.C.R.L., designed for more advanced training sessions with crew members on the train.
records.safeInformation: The modified Box MK.II model, unleashes a sword energy wave in a large area.
records.unitInformation: Connected to Combat System MK.II, this Box gains combat components and a retro-styled weapon, only to... Wait, what's with this super-powered sword wave?!

records.name: Verlaine

FoodList.letter: I made this surface food with Monday. It's going to be great!

records.birthdayMessage: I think I ordered the cake while I was half-asleep! Monday may have warned that it won't taste good, but we need to be adventurous, right? So, shall we try it?

ResumeList.des: Unlike most Ascenders, Verlaine's Ascension Ability has a unique expression and functionality, as seen in the hound-like creature accompanying her. The hound Monday is not a real animal or a man-made companion robot but an extension of Verlaine's ability. Her companion. This uniqueness leads to some issues — she is destined not to blend in with ordinary people and lacks common ground with most Ascenders. However, her lively and cheerful personality seems unaffected. According to her, it's all because of the precious friends by her side.

records.getCharacter: Hi, I'm Verlaine, I'm actually traveling right now, this is just a bit of hitchhiking along the way! ...Speaking of which, is my friend around here somewhere?

records.name: Box_F

ResumeList.des:
仿生技工十代，由铁盟科研部门与阿妮塔科技共同开发的多功能仿生机器人，一般被简称为波克士，用于辅助人类进行各种技术工作，拥有大量的衍生型号，但是因为造价十分昂贵，并未普及。

配置于列车上的波克士可以通过自身预先设定的程序规范辅助驾驶员进行列车的操作，在特殊时刻也可以代替驾驶员，利用预先录入的数据暂时接管列车的驾驶，波克士搭载有多媒体播放接口，可以接入车内的多媒体系统，播放包括音频和视频在内的各种多媒体介质。

为了与使用者更好地交流，并且缓解长途旅行带来的寂寞感和疲劳，“波克士”上搭载了基于数据库的仿生对话系统，“波克士”会基于数据库的反馈，实时地进行如同真人一样的对话交流，然而有些车长反映，与这些家伙对话的时候总会感觉到莫名的不爽，针对这些反馈，数据库提供方正在努力检讨中。

——来自波克士的产品介绍

records.name: Box Rocket Punch

——来自波克士的产品介绍

搭载在无垠号上的波克士，为了能够更高效地辅助列车长驾驶列车管控各项指标，以及应对一些突发情况，也实验性地接受了一些定制化的实验性改造。

无垠号列车上的波克士就为了辅助列车长，调用了更理性的仿生对话数据库与计算逻辑。

但可笑的是，当列车长与莉薇娅的资料被录入数据库中并经过一段时间分析后，这辆列车的波克士虽然正确地识别了列车长的身份，但却将同行的莉薇娅定位为了“这辆列车上地位最高的人”，哪怕之后又有数人先后登上列车成为列车上的常驻人员，波克士对莉薇娅无比恭敬的态度都不曾改变。
