records.name: Yejue

FoodList.letter: This is a delicious overtime meal that many colleagues gave high praises. Eat up! I'll make it for you again.

records.birthdayMessage: I got this trendy-looking cake that tastes not bad! After I get my pay raise and promotion, I'll treat you to it more often!

ResumeList.des: A pathfinder from Anita Energy Company wielding exploration equipment. She occasionally boards The Eternal on her way back to her Anita dormitory from the Chaos Space. She maintains a cheerful older sister demeanor in both work and life, a contrast to her partner Caroline's temperament. As a pragmatic doer, her dream is to become a successful person who can afford a big house, making her very concerned about salary, promotions, raises, and other material things... According to her, all her efforts are to make money. However, this honesty is reassuring. At least once paid, she completes her work earnestly — provided she doesn't argue with her partner midway.

records.getCharacter: I'm Yejue, dispatched by Anita Global Energy. Conductor, right? Nice to meet you!

records.name: Fenia
records.safeInformation: Fenia assures she knows when to strike. As a rising star in the Detroyer, she possesses such strength.

records.name: Aoba
records.safeInformation: Turning every mundane object around her into a weapon. A certain person's bodyguard. Comes and goes like a shadow.

records.name: Tobinezumi
records.safeInformation: A quiet NC Ninja. The way of the ninja lies in silence, not in the external show.

records.name: Solum
records.safeInformation: A helmet-wearing Night Chains guard, as swagy as she looks.

records.name: Maruha
records.safeInformation: Punishing villains is just a hobby, but fighting is usually work. Being her opponent doesn't mean you're a bad person.

records.name: Yamaarashi
records.safeInformation: Noisy NC Ninja. As swift as the wind! As fierce as fire!

records.name: Punch Me MK.I S
records.battleDes: The "Punch Me" series robots are equipped with a stable data analysis system, facilitating the testing of the attacker's power level.

records.name: Punch Me MK.I S Pro
records.battleDes: When the robot's damage tolerance threshold is surpassed, it indicates that the attacker's power has significantly exceeded the standard level.

records.name: Punch Me MK.I S Pro Max
records.battleDes: Producing and repairing robots takes time, and the crew members need to eat and sleep... So let's just wrap up the battle in a flash.

records.name: Punch Me MK.I S Pro Max +
records.battleDes: Don't underestimate this Punch Me robot that doesn't fight back. After all, even simply launching attacks requires a certain level of commanding skills.

records.name: Punch Me MK.I S Pro Max + Ultra
records.battleDes: The Punch Me MK.I series has completed its final update. Let's wreck it and let 'Punch Me' (and the Box above it) know who's the boss here!

records.name: Yoizuki
records.safeInformation: She uses every opportunity as a bargain chip, future family head, radiant as the moon.

records.name: Stella
records.safeInformation: Stella exudes confidence and determination in everything she does, and backs it up with real ability.

records.name: Bat Mob
records.safeInformation: A mob wielding a baseball bat for his attacks.
records.unitInformation: Clad in basic protective gear, this mob wields a baseball bat for relatively low threat attacks.

records.name: Shield Mob
records.safeInformation: A mob holding a riot shield, who primarily acts as cover for his companions.
records.unitInformation: Clad in basic protective gear, this mob uses a worn-out riot shield to cover his comrades.

records.name: Looter: Hammer
records.safeInformation: A heavily armed looter wielding a mace. When charged, he releases a powerful smite, stunning enemies in the area.
records.unitInformation: A heavily armed looter featuring a towering stature and wielding a long mace, posing a serious threat merely by his appearance. When charged, his powerful smite unleashes shockwaves that strike nearby enemies and stun them.

records.name: Axe Mob
records.safeInformation: A mob attacking with a fire axe.
records.unitInformation: Clad in basic protective gear, this mob wields a hand axe as a weapon, posing a certain threat up close.

records.name: Rifle Mob
records.safeInformation: A mob attacking with a modified sniper rifle. Watch out from afar!
records.unitInformation: Clad in basic protective gear, this mob is equipped with a self-modified rifle and usually snipes from a distance to deal massive damage.

records.name: Voltgun Mob
records.safeInformation: A mob attacking and assisting with a modified electromagnetic gun.
records.unitInformation: Clad in basic protective gear, this mob wields an electromagnetic gun acquired from unknown sources and uses it for attacks or generating electromagnetic shields to aid his companions.

records.name: Shotgun Mob
records.safeInformation: A mob carrying a shotgun and Molotov cocktails, threatening from both close and long distances.
records.unitInformation: Clad in basic protective gear, this mob is equipped with a self-modified shotgun and Molotov cocktails, suppressing with shotgun fire up close and throwing Molotov cocktails from afar.

records.name: Bat & Axe Mob
records.safeInformation: A mob wielding both a baseball bat and a hand axe, capable of switching weapons flexibly.
records.unitInformation: Clad in basic protective gear, this mob, with one hand holding a baseball bat and the other a hand axe, can dynamically choose which weapon to use in combat, making him a formidable opponent.

records.name: Shield & Bat Mob
records.safeInformation: A mob wielding both a baseball bat and a shield, who is particularly tricky at close range.
records.unitInformation: Clad in basic protective gear, this mob, with one hand holding a shield and the other a baseball bat, is adept at both offense and defense. Getting hit by the bat puts one in a stunned state, making him a quite formidable opponent.

records.name: Shield & Shotgun Mob
records.safeInformation: A mob wielding both a firearm and a shield, who is effective at various ranges.
records.unitInformation: Clad in basic protective gear, this mob, with one hand holding a shield and the other a firearm, is adept at both offense and defense. Possessing rudimentary tactical skills, he can utilize the shield to gain advantages, making him a formidable opponent.

records.name: Shotgun & Shield Mob
records.safeInformation: A mob wielding both a shotgun and a shield, who is effective at various ranges.
records.unitInformation: Clad in basic protective gear, this mob, with one hand holding a shield and the other a shotgun, is adept at both offense and defense. He can use the shield as cover for sustained gunfire, making him a formidable opponent.

records.name: Akimbo Mob
records.safeInformation: A mob wielding both a stun gun and a sniper rifle. A double-threat duo!
records.unitInformation: Clad in basic protective gear, this mob is armed with both a sniper rifle and a stun gun. He can assess situations in combat, flexibly employing one of the firearms for attacks or providing cover for allies, which makes him a formidable opponent.

records.idCN: 01敌方/05鼹鼠帮/动力甲链锯/鼹鼠帮·动力甲链锯
records.name: Molegang Chainsaw Mecha
records.safeInformation: A mob clad in homemade exoskeleton armor, who is the backbone of the team. When danger arises, he can retract his chainsaw and deploy a shield for defense, while also calling in small drones to airdrop explosives for crowd control.
records.unitInformation: Clad in homemade exoskeleton armor, this mob features saws on extending arm parts, often assuming a leadership role in groups. In critical moments, he can retract the saws, activate a shield for defense, and call in small drones to airdrop explosives for crowd control.

records.idCN: 01敌方/05鼹鼠帮/突击车暴徒/鼹鼠帮·突击车暴徒-后排
records.name: Molegang Buggy
records.safeInformation: A mob fighting in pairs who speed along while shooting rapidly and throwing Molotov cocktails.
records.unitInformation: A mob fighting in pairs, driving a modified jeep with a driver and a gunner. Besides using machine guns while speeding, they can also throw Molotov cocktails, making them formidable opponents.

records.idCN: 01敌方/05鼹鼠帮/鼹鼠重机/BOSS-鼹鼠重机
records.name: Molegang Machinery
records.safeInformation: After being "retrieved" by terrorists, it was transformed into an efficient and powerful weapon. The multifunctional forearm originally used for obstacle clearing has now deviated from its original function, possessing greater lethality in combat.
records.unitInformation:
地联在篝火城计划初期为了更方便地铺设轨道而设计的大型清障工程车，在轨道上可以进行高效率作业，紧急情况下也可以脱离轨道运转，只是性能会受到影响。
在被恐怖分子们“回收”以后被改造成了高效且强力的兵器，原本用于清障的多功能前臂现在已脱离了原本的功能，在战斗方面具备了更大的杀伤性。

records.idCN: 01敌方/02桦树/浮游/骨朵/骨朵-后排-回血
records.name: CR: Bud
records.safeInformation: A common Chaos Remain with a solid exoskeleton.
records.unitInformation:
覆盖着坚韧外甲的桦树生物。当它移动时，看起来就像是包裹在岩石中的、不断变幻着的虹色液体，美丽，也极为危险。
更偏重防御的类型，厚重的外甲足以阻挡大部分火力。

records.name: Looter: Claymore
records.safeInformation: A heavily armed looter wielding a greatsword. His arm armor enables a firm grip on enemies.
records.unitInformation: A heavily armed looter armed with a greatsword. His modified arm armor enables a firm grip on targets, effectively immobilizing them.

records.idCN: 01敌方/03劫掠者/劫掠者·执电-后排
records.name: Looter: Bolt
records.safeInformation: A heavily armed looter, capable of utilizing electrokinetic ascension abilities.
records.unitInformation: A heavily armed looter who stands out as a rare ascender among their peers. Despite being unarmed, this ascender launches attacks using their ascension ability, primarily through lightning bolts.

records.name: N.A. Vanguard
records.safeInformation: A remnant of an ancient northern nation, capable of throwing mechanical axes to cause slashing damage.
records.unitInformation: A remnant of an ancient northern nation, still clad in outdated and cumbersome power armor. Able to throw mechanical axes to cause slashing damage.

records.idCN: 01敌方/08军阀/北阵残部·重机枪兵-后排
records.name: N.A. HMG
records.safeInformation: A remnant of an ancient northern nation, wielding a heavy machine gun as a handheld weapon.
records.unitInformation: A remnant of an ancient northern nation, still clad in outdated and cumbersome power armor. This armor enables an ordinary soldier to wield a heavy machine gun as a handheld weapon.

records.idCN: 01敌方/08军阀/北阵残部·榴弹枪兵-后排
records.name: N.A. GL
records.safeInformation: A remnant of an ancient northern nation, capable of using a grenade launcher to inflict Ignite damage with grenades.
records.unitInformation: A remnant of an ancient northern nation, still clad in outdated and cumbersome power armor. Able to use a grenade launcher to inflict Ignite damage with grenades.

records.name: Scorpion
records.safeInformation: The cold, austere markings, formidable armaments, and exceptional structural stability indicate that the armor before you must have served in the ranks of the N.A..
records.unitInformation:
无论从时代还是环境角度考虑都不应该出现在此地的战车。
冷冽简洁的涂饰、破坏力极强的武装，以及极高的结构稳定性，这些特征揭示了眼前这辆战车应该是曾经服役于“北方阵线”的型号。在“北阵”解散多年后的现在，北方阵线的机械现身于此的原因，还是个谜。

records.name: Wensheng
records.safeInformation: The type that spells trouble if encountered, emitting an aura of stay-away. Hopefully, losing in combat won't lead to him being arrested by the BCRL Agency.

records.name: Rina Von
records.safeInformation: For bonuses, performance, overtime compensation... the salary structure of the Destroyer is so complicated that it led Director Rina Von to step onto the battlefield.

records.idCN: 01敌方/02桦树/浮游/雌蕊/雌蕊-后排
records.name: CR: Pistil
records.safeInformation: A beautiful plant-like Chaos Remain, capable of causing stun.
records.unitInformation: 纤长的桦树生物。当它移动时，看起来就像是包裹在岩石中的、不断变幻着的虹色液体，美丽，也极为危险。使用秘能聚集而成的光束攻击，能够贯穿人体并造成眩晕。

records.idCN: 01敌方/02桦树/浮游/雄蕊/雄蕊-后排
records.name: CR: Stamen
records.safeInformation: A beautiful Chaos Remain resembling a plant. It unleashes high-intensity beam attacks upon releasing its core.
records.unitInformation: This Chaos Remain is capable of transforming by concealing its core. In its common state, the outer membrane envelops the core, remaining motionless. Once the core is unleashed, it continuously unleashes high-intensity beam attacks.

records.name: Barricade
records.safeInformation: A sturdy barricade that must be destroyed to proceed.

records.idCN: 01敌方/03劫掠者/劫掠者·执火/劫掠者·执火-中排
records.name: Looter: Flame
records.safeInformation: A heavily armed looter, with a flamethrower capable of locking onto stunned enemies to unleash a concentrated stream of flames.
records.unitInformation: A heavily armed looter featuring a towering stature and wielding a deadly flamethrower. The flamethrower has been modified illegally, granting it the ability to lock onto stunned enemies and unleash a devastating fire beam. However, it cannot lock onto non-stunned enemies.

records.idCN: 01敌方/02桦树/触须/钵爪体/钵爪体-中排
records.name: CR: Claw
records.safeInformation: A Chaos Remain capable of gradually spreading morphic field pollution, posing a significant threat to affected enemies.
records.unitInformation: A Chaos Remain with a claw-like exoskeleton. It has the ability to spread and intensify morphic field pollution, posing a great threat to affected enemies.

records.idCN: 01敌方/02桦树/触须/多倍体/多倍体-前排
records.name: CR: Multicore
records.safeInformation: A Chaos Remain with multiple cores that can suppress the abilities of Ascenders.
records.unitInformation: A Chaos Remain with a hammer-like exoskeleton. It not only strikes enemies with brute force but also disrupts enemy ascension abilities through psychic attacks.

records.idCN: 01敌方/02桦树/触须/摄能体/摄能体-前排
records.name: CR: Absorber
records.safeInformation: A Chaos Remain capable of reducing your cost, with skills causing area damage.
records.unitInformation: A more formidable Chaos Remain that can absorb enemy energy and influence the battlefield by reducing your cost. Its skills cause area damage.

records.idCN: 01敌方/02桦树/触须/管胞体/管胞体-后排
records.name: CR: Tracheid
records.safeInformation: A powerful Chaos Remain capable of suppressing the abilities of Ascenders.
records.unitInformation: A more formidable Chaos Remain that requires at least a squad for direct engagement. Possessing extraordinary strength, it can suppress Ascenders' abilities.

records.idCN: 01敌方/02桦树/触须/刺须体/刺须体-后排飞行
records.name: CR: Spine
records.safeInformation: An evolved Chaos Remain that can summon other smaller Chaos Remains to fight alongside them.
records.unitInformation: An evolved Chaos Remain that typically operates alongside other Chaos Remains. It can launch attacks from a distance and summon other smaller Chaos Remains to assist in combat.

records.name: Arcana
records.safeInformation: A seasoned adventurer and traveler. Beware of her old staff.

records.name: Tara
records.safeInformation: Planning to buy some good food with Cook after the battle ends.

records.idCN: 01敌方/02桦树/浮游/骨朵/骨朵-后排-自爆
records.name: CR: Bud

records.idCN: 01敌方/04拾荒者/拾荒者·铁管力士
records.name: Marauder Steel Pipe
records.safeInformation: A marauder carrying a cactus and wielding a steel pipe. He can charge up to enhance his ATK and effects.
records.unitInformation: A fully armed marauder, flaunting red-painted armor and carrying a cactus for pollution resistance. Wielding a steel pipe scavenged from unknown sources as a weapon, he can charge up to enhance his ATK and effects.

records.idCN: 01敌方/04拾荒者/拾荒者·榴弹组-后排
records.name: Marauder Grenadier
records.safeInformation: A marauder carrying a cactus and wielding a grenade launcher with inconsistent ammunition quality, which results in unpredictable explosion effects.
records.unitInformation: A marauder wearing striking red sportswear and a gas mask, with a cactus that provides slight pollution resistance. Although he's equipped with a grenade launcher, the quality of the ammunition varies, making each shot a gamble.

records.idCN: 01敌方/04拾荒者/拾荒者·火枪组-后排
records.name: Marauder Musketeer
records.safeInformation: A marauder carrying a cactus and wielding a flintlock pistol. Sometimes he throws Molotov cocktails as weapons.
records.unitInformation: A marauder wearing striking red sportswear and a gas mask, with a cactus that provides slight pollution resistance. Armed with a flintlock pistol, he sometimes uses Molotov cocktails as supplementary attack methods.

records.idCN: 01敌方/04拾荒者/拾荒者·喷火力士-中排
records.name: Marauder Flamethrower
records.safeInformation: A marauder carrying a cactus, featuring a towering stature and swift movements, wielding a deadly flamethrower.
records.unitInformation: A fully armed marauder flaunting red-painted armor, boasting robust bodies and agile movements. He carries a cactus that provides pollution resistance and can be used as a weapon. His primary weapon is a flamethrower, capable of emitting devastating flames.

records.idCN: 01敌方/04拾荒者/穿击动力甲/BOSS-荒原王·穿击动力甲
records.name: Wilderness King: Power Driller
records.safeInformation: Tom the Wilderness King's vehicle. Uses the recharge armored firearms to shoot and stun the target, and after breaking your character's shield, uses a drill attack to inflict an injure effect.
records.unitInformation: A versatile mecha left over from the Earth Union era, its design and manufacturing styles reflect the characteristics of that time. While the B.C.R.L. has become the dominant power, some power mechas are still in use, while others have been abandoned or resold for various reasons. One such power mecha fell into the hands of an ambitious marauder, who gave it a fancy name "The Wilderness King." However, this document refers to it as the "Power Driller."\nIt is equipped with powerful firearms that launch charged attacks, striking and stunning the target. Additionally, it can unleash drill attacks after breaking any crew member's shield, dealing DMG to the target and inflicting Injure.

records.name: Haruka

FoodList.letter: After repairing the train, this is the perfect meal... Wanna join?

records.birthdayMessage: It's noisy out there. For my sake, you won't be using the train much today, right? I'd like to take a day off...

ResumeList.des: A famous ghost crew member of The Eternal, working as a COLUMBA train repair technician, and the owner of the Blue Cat, Dodo. These three identities make up Haruka's exceptionally simple life. Her lack of presence and non-existent social initiative make her someone that is overlooked. But she has no complaints about it and is content with the status quo. When it comes to repairing trains, Haruka is the most reliable partner.

records.getCharacter: ...Haruka, that's my name. Maintenance is my job, and you just focus on yours.

records.name: Dual Axe Mob
records.safeInformation: A mob wielding two hand axes, swing back and forth.
records.unitInformation: Clad in basic protective gear, this spirited mob wields axes in both hands and can launch alternating attacks from left to right, making him a formidable opponent.

records.name: Joshua

FoodList.letter: Dozed off while baking. But it doesn't seem burnt, so don't be picky.

records.birthdayMessage: Human's birthday is completely meaningless to me... And this cake... It appeared out of nowhere too. But I'm sure there is a reason for that. How about you eat it for me?

ResumeList.des: Literally a floating crew member from the Citadel, an "Angel". Goes about most daily activities floating in the air. This individual used to be called Joshua, but now that has become a code name — after all, feedback from some former colleagues and friends claims that the current Joshua is completely different from the one they knew. Also, all information about the Angel must remain confidential, and any written material unvetted by Joshua is considered invalid. Thus, this archive entry refers to Joshua as "they" and "the individual". Kindly note this.

records.getCharacter: I'm Joshua. As an Angel of the Citadel, I can teach you profound knowledge that ordinary people can't understand. Please refrain from asking, "Teacher, what does this mean~" or other similarly silly questions.

records.idCN: 01敌方/02桦树/爆虫/鸣爆虫/鸣爆虫
records.name: Toxic Blastbug
records.safeInformation: Resembling a giant reptile carrying crystals on its back, it has relatively simple attack methods compared to other Chaos Remains but releases dangerous energy when self-destructing.
records.unitInformation: Among the smaller Chaos Remains, it's larger in size and often appears in groups. It typically launches Basic Attacks and explodes when taking lethal DMG. It can cause greater damage than common Blastbugs and can even exhibit abnormal growth, increasing damage with size.

records.idCN: 01敌方/02桦树/浮游/浮游/3D浮游-飞行0.5
records.name: Floating CR Remain
records.safeInformation: A common floating-type Chaos Remain, relatively weak in strength.
records.unitInformation: A common floating-type Chaos Remain, weak in strength, capable only of ranged attacks. It often accompanies larger Chaos Remains.

records.name: Blastbug
records.safeInformation: Resembling a giant reptile carrying crystals on its back, it has relatively simple attack methods compared to other Chaos Remains but releases dangerous energy when self-destructing.
records.unitInformation: A small Chaos Remain usually appearing in groups. It lacks effective attack methods but can attack through self-destruct. The energy released upon explosion causes significant damage to humans.

records.idCN: 01敌方/02桦树/爆虫/鸣爆虫母/BOSS-鸣爆虫母
records.name: Blastbug Matriarch
records.safeInformation: The queen who breeds and commands the Blastbugs, not only has destructive power and an attack range far exceeding ordinary individuals, but can also summon a large number of offspring for self-destruct attacks.
records.unitInformation: The largest and most powerful individual among Blastbugs, she is the queen who reproduces and leads them. The most prominent feature is her ability to summon swarms of Blastbugs for large-scale collective attacks.

records.idCN: 01敌方/02桦树/山野/浑噩镰蕨/浑噩镰蕨
records.name: Chaos Mantis
records.safeInformation: A Chaos Remain with an insect-like appearance, able to become invisible. Its scythe-like limbs can swiftly dismantle target defenses.
records.unitInformation: A more formidable Chaos Remain that requires at least a squad for direct engagement. With an exoskeleton resembling certain insects, its scythe-like limbs can dissolve target defenses with multi-stage attacks. It can instantly approach targets while invisible and launch powerful attacks, capable of breaking through front lines in an instant. It's a highly threatening enemy.

records.idCN: 01敌方/试炼场/挨揍宝2000剑/挨揍宝2000S
records.name: Punch Me MK.II S
records.battleDes: The "Punch Me MK.II" series is equipped with a more stable data analysis system, facilitating easier testing of changes in the attacker's power level.

records.idCN: 01敌方/试炼场/挨揍宝2000剑/挨揍宝2000SPRO
records.name: Punch Me MK.II S Pro
records.battleDes: When the robot's damage tolerance threshold is surpassed, it indicates that the attacker's power has significantly exceeded the standard level.

records.idCN: 01敌方/试炼场/挨揍宝2000剑/挨揍宝2000SPROMAX
records.name: Punch Me MK.II S Pro Max
records.battleDes: Producing and repairing robots takes time... but for the crew, it feels like, 'Why are we fighting those robots again? Didn't we just do this yesterday?!'

records.idCN: 01敌方/试炼场/挨揍宝2000剑/挨揍宝2000SPROMAXPLUS
records.name: Punch Me MK.II S Pro Max Plus
records.battleDes: As a commander, you must be a pro at handling enemy's straightforward attacks, right? Come on, give it a shot!

records.idCN: 01敌方/试炼场/挨揍宝2000剑/挨揍宝2000SPROMAXPLUSULTRA
records.name: Punch Me MK.II S Pro Max Plus + Ultra
records.battleDes: The Punch Me MK.II series has completed its final update. Let's wreck it and ensure no more 'Punch Me' series ever dare to set foot on The Eternal again!

records.idCN: 01敌方/02桦树/爆虫/鸣爆虫/鸣爆虫2倍体
records.name: Toxic Blastbug Diploid
records.safeInformation: Resembling a giant reptile carrying crystals on its back, it has relatively simple attack methods compared to other Chaos Remains but releases dangerous energy when self-destructing.
records.unitInformation: Among the smaller Chaos Remains, it's larger in size and often appears in groups. It typically launches Basic Attacks and explodes when taking lethal DMG. It can cause greater damage than common Blastbugs and can even exhibit abnormal growth, increasing damage with size.

records.idCN: 01敌方/02桦树/爆虫/鸣爆虫/鸣爆虫4倍体
records.name: Toxic Blastbug Tetraploid
records.safeInformation: Resembling a giant reptile carrying crystals on its back, it has relatively simple attack methods compared to other Chaos Remains but releases dangerous energy when self-destructing.

records.name: Hayabusa

FoodList.letter: There's no shame in being a sweet tooth. Oh, no surprise inside. Don't worry.

records.birthdayMessage: I'll take you to try the strawberry parfait in Night Chains Land next time. Its taste is simply unparalleled. But for now, try imagining it with this cake... Prank? No, it's definitely not.

ResumeList.des: A mysterious young man who comes and goes without a trace. Perpetrator of many bad deeds and a few good ones — good and evil are so ambiguous to him that all accusations against him seem weak and meaningless. Simply classifying him as a cunning enemy is not quite right, but treating him as a friend too soon is recipe for exploitation with worse consequences. No matter how strong or mysterious a person is, one would have a past and weaknesses. What secrets lie in Hayabusa's past? And what unimaginable weakness does he have?

records.getCharacter: Hey, I'm Hayabusa. No welcome for me?

records.name: Arina

FoodList.letter: These are filled with my deepest feelings~ You must finish them, Conductor~

records.birthdayMessage: Will you come and see me today? I truly yearn to spend this special day with you... Please let me do something for you! Anything!

ResumeList.des: Arina seems to be an ever-present member of the Night Chains, but on closer inspection, it's clear her actions are in sync with Conductor's. When Conductor returns to The Eternal, she would often be waiting on the train with a smile. Arina's Ascension Ability allows her to summon three mirror images. Customers are often startled by multiple Arinas when they first enter the rest area — however, the drinks she prepares are delicious, making it easy for people to let their guard down and open up to her. Whether this is a prelude to getting close to her or falling into a trap... only time will tell.

records.getCharacter: We meet again, Conductor. I'm Arina, the bartender.

records.name: Nabi

FoodList.letter: This is one way to replenish energy rapidly, and I put some effort in the taste too. Eat up.

records.birthdayMessage: It's a bit bitter but incredibly rich in flavor. Thank you for taking care of me all this time.

ResumeList.des: Nabi, a Night Chains executor, doesn't serve the large organization directly. She has another identity that she prioritizes over her role as executor, and that is Hayabusa's bodyguard, even though it's a role assigned by someone else. She dresses simply and does things in a straightforward manner. She rarely engages in unnecessary interactions. You might occasionally see Nabi sitting by a window, sketching with a pencil — one of her few hobbies.

records.getCharacter: I'm Nabi, tasked to assist you with your work. Orders, please.

records.name: Yer

FoodList.letter: The method in this recipe wasn't quite the same as what I'd learned before. This is the result of combining the two.

records.birthdayMessage: The cake shop declined my request for a grapefruit-flavored cake. A little disappointing... though this one isn't bad either. A colleague recommended it.

ResumeList.des: Yer specialises on drone development. Unlike gardeners who stay in a lab for extended periods, she travels frequently between research bases to assist with everyone's research and operations, establishing good relationships with many colleagues. As one whose action speaks louder than words, Yer comes across as competent and reliable. Although she maintains appropriate distance from others, it does not stop her from being a trusted figure.

records.getCharacter: Hello, Conductor. I'm Yer from Anita. I'd like a workroom to myself, and during working hours, please remind the other crew not to wander in.

records.idCN: 01敌方/02桦树/山野/混厄枸骨/混厄枸骨-后排
records.name: Chaos Citrus
records.safeInformation: A Chaos Remain resembling a plant. Its exoskeleton can converge to form a shield for protection. After charging, it can release telekinetic attacks that ripple outwards.
records.unitInformation: A more formidable Chaos Remain that requires at least a squad for direct engagement. Resembling certain plant species, its attacks typically inflict psychic damage and can drive petals to converge in front of itself as a defensive measure. After charging, it releases telekinetic attacks that ripple outwards, affecting targets within its range.

records.name: Chaos Coral
records.safeInformation: A Chaos Remain resembling coral. It emits a powdery substance that continuously affects nearby targets and can also generate flames.
records.unitInformation: A Chaos Remain with a head resembling coral. It emits a powdery substance, inflicting ongoing effects on those within its vicinity. Additionally, it can unleash flames with a large range, and the longer it charges, the stronger the generated flames become.

records.idCN: 01敌方/02桦树/山野/昏恶渡鸦/昏恶渡鸦-后排
records.name: Chaos Raven
records.safeInformation: An avian-like Chaos Remain with an expandable head exoskeleton. It inflicts Reverengy DMG on targets within the area after charging.
records.unitInformation: Named "Raven" due to its avian-like nature, this Chaos Remain has luminescent head exoskeleton. While most of its attacks pose minor threats, it can inflict Reverengy DMG on a large area of enemies after prolonged charging. When it's suspended in the air, its charging status must be closely monitored.

records.name: Chaos Bloom
records.safeInformation: A Chaos Remain resembling a plant. Its exoskeleton can converge to form a shield for protection.
records.unitInformation: A Chaos Remain resembling certain plant species. Its petal-shaped exoskeleton blooms like flowers in a relaxed state. It attacks by clustering its head petals together. When facing danger, it releases its petals to form a shield in front of it to ward off threats.

records.name: Chaos Pigeon
records.safeInformation: A Chaos Remain with an avian-like feature and eye-like structure on its head exoskeleton. It inflicts Reverengy DMG on targets within the area.
records.unitInformation: A Chaos Remain resembling a bird, posing a threat to both individuals and groups. The "eyes" around its head emit a glowing light, causing those caught in their gaze to suffer Reverengy DMG and become immobilized. It is crucial to be wary of their attack signs.

records.name: Shire
records.safeInformation: A member of the P.U.S. named Shire, who is completely different from her appearance, a very formidable Ascender. The big goose that never leaves her side is her good partner.
records.unitInformation:
体型、外表乃至嗓音都会让人觉得“只不过是个孩子”的升构者，沙盗团成员。使用与外形完全不符的霰弹枪进行战斗，有许多人会被第一印象蒙骗，认为那不过是玩具而已。将她视为“可爱的孩子”而降低戒心的行为是十分危险的，轻视她的人通常会被教训得很惨。
经常被目击到和随身携带的鹅对话，据说是真的在进行沟通。

records.name: P.U.S. Rider
records.safeInformation: A member of the elusive P.U.S., able to inflict Ignite and Break on crew members.
records.unitInformation: Clad in a heavy sun protection mask, this member of the P.U.S. roams the wilderness and desert regions with uncanny stealth. He can inflict Ignite damage and use a long spear to execute powerful charges, applying Break on crew members.

records.idCN: 01敌方/09沙盗团/沙盗斧手/沙盗斧手
records.name: P.U.S. Axeman
records.safeInformation: A member of the elusive P.U.S., able to inflict Ignite and Rend damage on crew members.
records.unitInformation: Clad in a heavy sun protection mask, this member of the P.U.S. roams the wilderness and desert regions with uncanny stealth. He strikes from a distance with thrown axes, inflicting Ignite and Rend damage on crew members.

records.idCN: 01敌方/06深眠者/深眠者·迷途-火剑
records.name: DS: Astray
records.safeInformation: A Deep Sleeper often found in areas heavily polluted by morphic fields, able to imbue weapons with Fire DMG, causing a Flare effect.
records.unitInformation: Often found in areas heavily polluted by morphic fields, this Deep Sleeper has regenerated body parts into dagger-like forms. He can swiftly slash targets with flaming daggers, inflicting significant Fire DMG on a single target and causing a Flare effect.

records.idCN: 01敌方/06深眠者/深眠者·迷踪-电剑
records.name: DS: Lost
records.safeInformation: A Deep Sleeper often found in areas heavily polluted by morphic fields, able to deal Electro DMG to weapons and block incoming attacks. His counterattacks during blocking can imprison targets within the area.
records.unitInformation: Often found in areas heavily polluted by morphic fields, this Deep Sleeper can apply sustainable Electro DMG to weapons and use them to block attacks. The DMG taken during blocking enhances his counterattack, which inflicts Electro DMG and can imprison targets within the area.

records.idCN: 01敌方/06深眠者/深眠者·迷离-后排-冰
records.name: DS: Dazed
records.safeInformation: A Deep Sleeper often found in areas heavily polluted by morphic fields, able to launch frost attacks and inflict a Chill effect. Also has the ability to restore health and reduce DMG taken by other enemies.
records.unitInformation: Often found in areas heavily polluted by morphic fields, this Deep Sleeper remains dedicated to aiding her companions despite her altered appearance. Her attacks typically inflict Frost DMG and apply a Chill effect. Additionally, she can restore health to other Deep Sleepers and use force fields to reduce DMG taken by her companions.

records.idCN: 01敌方/06深眠者/深眠者·迷惘/深眠者·迷惘-后排-诅咒
records.name: DS: Confused
records.safeInformation: A Deep Sleeper often found in areas heavily polluted by morphic fields, able to launch arcane attacks and imprison targets within a certain range.
records.unitInformation: Often found in areas heavily polluted by morphic fields, this Deep Sleeper retains a human appearance but has deteriorated internally, especially his hands. Primarily uses arcane attacks to damage targets from a distance and can imprison targets within a certain range.

records.idCN: 01敌方/08军阀/北阵残部·动力甲重炮-后排
records.name: N.A. Mecha Cannon
records.safeInformation: A military-spec exoskeletal mecha with firepower support capabilities, capable of launching missiles or cannon attacks. It can lock onto stunned enemies for shooting.
records.unitInformation: Clearly manufactured from military production lines, this exoskeletal mecha is designed primarily for long-range fire support. It is outfitted with heavy artillery and missile launchers. Its missile attacks can inflict significant damage on enemies and have a stunning effect. Additionally, it can lock onto stunned enemies and unleash devastating firepower, causing immense damage.

records.idCN: 01敌方/08军阀/北阵残部·动力甲援护-中排
records.name: N.A. Mecha Support
records.safeInformation: A military-spec exoskeletal mecha, equipped with dual arms capable of unleashing electric attacks. It boasts versatile attack methods, offering flexibility in combat.
records.unitInformation: Clearly manufactured from military production lines, this exoskeletal mecha emphasizes agility and suppression in battle. Featuring high-voltage output ports on both arms, it can unleash electric attacks. Equipped with a basic intelligent analysis system, it can deftly assess and respond to enemy behavior.

records.idCN: 01敌方/08军阀/北阵残部·动力甲先锋
records.name: N.A. Mecha Vanguard
records.safeInformation: A military-spec exoskeletal mecha with enhanced arm strength, capable of smiting the ground or hurling objects to stun enemies.
records.unitInformation: Clearly manufactured from military production lines, this exoskeletal mecha is designed for frontal engagements. It features carbon steel armor and shock modules on both arms. It can stun nearby enemies by activating the shock modules to smite the ground or momentarily increase output to hurl objects and incapacitate foes.

records.idCN: 01敌方/04拾荒者/拾荒者·火枪先锋-中排
records.name: Marauder Igniter
records.safeInformation: A marauder armed with a firearm for dealing Ignite damage.
records.unitInformation: A marauder wearing striking red sportswear and an impact-resistant mask. He attacks with a firearm, inflicting Ignite damage on crew members.

records.idCN: 01敌方/04拾荒者/拾荒者·长枪先锋-中排
records.name: Marauder Pikeman
records.safeInformation: A marauder armed with a spear, capable of long-range shield-breaking attacks.
records.unitInformation: A marauder wearing striking red sportswear and an impact-resistant mask, able to attack from a distance due to his long-handled weapon. His specially treated spear can break through defenses, featuring a shield-breaking effect.

records.idCN: 01敌方/04拾荒者/拾荒者·后援组-后排
records.name: Marauder Flagman
records.safeInformation: A marauder carrying a cactus and wielding a staff imbued with arcane energy. Once the staff's energy is depleted, he joins other flag bearers in combat or uses flag semaphore to signal the arrival of reinforcements to the battlefield.
records.unitInformation:
背有旗帜的拾荒者，为确保行动时的灵活度，只穿戴了简易防护道具。携带着能够提供轻微抗污染效果的仙人掌。大多数情况下不会单独出现，作为拾荒者组织的旗手，他们可以指挥拾荒者车队进行攻击。
旗手最初会使用长杖倾泻秘能，在能量用完后，其中一位旗手会拔出旗帜，指示其他旗手进行近身拳击，或者一同拔出旗帜打出旗语，在一套旗语动作结束后，被指引而来的车队将会对全体敌人进行冲锋。

records.idCN: 01敌方/04拾荒者/拾荒者·扶危组-后排
records.name: Marauder Wheelchair
records.safeInformation: A marauder reliant on a wheelchair, who relies on a specially cultivated cactus for support. This cactus has the ability to transmit pain to enemies.
records.unitInformation: A marauder who moves using a wheelchair, with an IV drip attached and holding a specially cultivated cactus. This unique cactus not only purifies pollutants but also secretes substances that can heal external wounds. Additionally, the marauder can induce self-harm with the cactus, transmitting his own pain to inflict psychological attacks on enemies.

records.name: Mole
records.safeInformation: The leader of the MoleGang, known as "Inferno Maelstrom." It attacks by throwing Molotov cocktails, and commands minions to set up landmine barricades. Capable of summoning a fleet of vehicles to cause disturbances.
records.unitInformation:
The leader of the MoleGang, known as "Inferno Maelstrom." He and his gang members operate in the underground area of Shoggolith City. When it comes to their style, it is like...
"We rock them top brands, we're lookin' fly! We roll deep, packin' weapons, super badass high! Don't sleep on our Molotov, they're ready to ignite! Underestimate us, we'll send you soaring, takin' flight!"
"Hey boss? Why do we have to introduce ourselves in a rap flow?'
"You idiot! Because that's COOOOOOOL!"
He throws Molotov cocktails at his enemies. Additionally, he can summon MoleGang minions to join the battle, and some of these minions are equipped with claymore landmines that deal explosive damage. Such is the power of MoleGang, the most badass crew in Shoggolith City!

records.idCN: 01敌方/05鼹鼠帮/动力甲轰火/鼹鼠帮·动力甲轰火-后排
records.name: Molegang Blaze Mecha
records.safeInformation: A power mecha modified by the MoleGang, employing a handheld cannon as its primary offensive tactic.
records.unitInformation: Modified by the MoleGang, this power mecha requires manual control by a driver. Its hands have been modified to wield a large handheld cannon for area attacks.

records.idCN: 01敌方/05鼹鼠帮/动力甲钢拳/鼹鼠帮·动力甲钢拳
records.name: Molegang Steel Mecha
records.safeInformation: A power mecha modified by the MoleGang, employing physical attacks as its primary offensive tactic.
records.unitInformation: Modified by the MoleGang, this power mecha requires manual control by a driver. Its upper limbs are specially reinforced and can even destroy fragile structures, hurling large debris as projectiles for attacks.

records.idCN: 01敌方/05鼹鼠帮/动力甲激电/鼹鼠帮·动力甲激电-后排
records.name: Molegang Electro Mecha
records.safeInformation: A power mecha modified by the MoleGang, employing Electrify attacks as its primary offensive tactic.
records.unitInformation: Modified by the MoleGang, this power mecha requires manual control by a driver. Unlike other mechas proficient in physical attacks, it specializes in its Electrify ability, capable of widespread interference on the battlefield.

records.idCN: 00我方/09召唤物/多萝西/bot01_莱格爆爆
records.name: Legge Bomber

records.idCN: 01敌方/试炼场/挨揍蝎/挨揍蝎-毁灭级
records.name: Punching Scorpion - Destruction

records.idCN: 01敌方/试炼场/挨揍蝎/挨揍蝎-陨星级
records.name: Punching Scorpion - Meteor
Kaleya

FoodList.letter: It's such a pity I can't always be there to take care of you, so please enjoy this...!

records.birthdayMessage: I was going to get the cake shop to make a porcelain-shaped cake, but they adamantly refused. Regardless, this is all right too. Give it a try! Be careful not to chip your teeth!

ResumeList.des: With her youthful appearance and usual outfit, Kaleya is often mistaken by those who don't know her as a new intern nurse in Anita. In reality, she is a capable Gardener familiar with the Chaos Space's environment, and often provides her comrades with environmental support. Gentle, generous, and knowledgeable, Kaleya is popular and trusted by her colleagues. Perhaps to compensate for the regret of being unable to use her physician's license, Kaleya is always eager to offer medical support when needed.

records.getCharacter: Hello, I'm Kaleya from Anita. If there's anything I can help you with, feel free to ask.

records.name: Miss Gold
records.battleDes: The leader of the Nugget Mechs can drive all Nugget Mechs to release their skills together.
records.safeInformation: The leader of the Nugget Mechs, cannot be damaged when other Nugget Mechs are on the field. It can drive all Nugget Mechs to release skills together.
records.unitInformation: Miss Gold, the guardian of ONEderland, possesses keen insight and leadership qualities. Both her arms can be detached to become rocket fists, and even each finger can be dismantled. As the leader of the Nugget Mechs, she can motivate her subordinates physically and mentally, creating chaos on the battlefield. When protected by other Nugget Mechs, she is invincible.

records.name: Nugget Mech No. 1
records.safeInformation: A common Nugget Mech that can inflict electro and Physical DMG. When it sustains excessive damage, it gains a shield and becomes paralyzed.
records.unitInformation: BOI3, a small auxiliary robot designed for transportation tasks, represents an early model of the Android Mechanic series jointly developed by Anita and the former Earth Union. Due to its widespread use in gold panning operations, it has affectionately been nicknamed the "Nugget Mech."

records.name: Nugget Mech No. 2
records.safeInformation: A common Nugget Mech that can inflict electro and Physical DMG. When it sustains excessive damage, it gains a shield and becomes paralyzed.
records.unitInformation: BOI3, a small auxiliary robot designed for transportation tasks, represents an early model of the Android Mechanic series jointly developed by Anita and the former Earth Union. Due to its widespread use in gold panning operations, it has affectionately been nicknamed the "Nugget Mech."

records.name: Lin

FoodList.letter: This awesome creation is featured in a video that showcases how it was made. Looks super cute, right?

records.birthdayMessage: I made it by myself. It's my first time making such a large cake. Looks okay... right? Should taste good too. Hope you like it...

ResumeList.des: As a Night Chains executor, Lin comes across as a very introverted girl. She rarely communicates or cooperates with others and shows little emotional fluctuation. This isn't surprising in a group like Night Chains where many prefer working alone. Her exquisite albeit low-key fashion sense, her occasional emotional outbursts that startle those around her, and her calm demeanor when facing bloody scenes suggest that Lin is quite a unique girl.

records.getCharacter: Lin. That's my name... Um, that's about it...

records.name: Ganya

FoodList.letter: My grandpa always used to say, make sure to eat on time, because if you don't, your stomach will give you a hard time.

records.birthdayMessage: If I were to bring a cake like this back to Mander Mine, it will definitely be snatched clean by everyone within minutes... But before that, I'd like you to eat it first. It's a gift to you for the kindness you've always shown me.

ResumeList.des: Captain of BCRL Team Meerkat. Unlike the more mobile Team Ratel, Team Meerkat deals with logistics and special situations. Ganya was chosen as Team Meerkat's captain for several reasons: she is from Mander Mine, excelled in training camp, and has performed well in her job. She is responsible and steady. Amongst the problematic Team Meerkat, Ganya stands out as the normal one. However, Rachel, Ilona, and Reika all trust and like this captain, though Reika may never admit it.

records.getCharacter: Captain of BCRL Team Meerkat, Ganya. I haven't prepared any gifts, so don't plan some welcome ceremony. Let's just get down to work.

records.name: Dustin

FoodList.letter: Those two children love this. Take this opportunity to rest for a while.

records.birthdayMessage: Though this body of mine can no longer take in food, I do hope you will enjoy sharing this cake together.

ResumeList.des: The Citadel's core personnel and leader of the Destroyer. Based on his appearance, it is difficult to determine if he's still human. His limbs, skin, and even some organs have been replaced by machinery, leaving only a few traces of his human identity. If everything has a reason, then Dustin sacrificed so much to survive and continue fighting to create a peaceful world for the children — Thus, he's willing to pay any price to guide and accompany the children he loves toward the future.

records.getCharacter: I'm Dustin of Source Citadel. Revealing hope to the world is my mission. I look forward to working with you, Conductor.

records.name: NC Katana
records.safeInformation: A common member of the Night Chains, wielding swords as weapons. He appears unassuming and poses a seemingly low threat.
records.unitInformation: A common member of the Night Chains, wielding swords as weapons. He seems reserved and low-key, giving off an impression of low threat.

records.idCN: 01敌方/06深眠者/柯娜/BOSS-柯娜-1阶段背誓者
records.name: Oathbreaker
records.unitInformation: This imposing Deep Sleeper evokes unease with just a glance. Her terrifying appearance, towering shield, and constant whispering instill fear in her adversaries. Among the known Deep Sleepers, she stands out as a formidable opponent with a deep-seated obsession.\nHer fighting style triggers a sense of deja vu. When did she take the oath she has now broken?

records.idCN: 01敌方/06深眠者/柯娜/BOSS-柯娜-2阶段破誓者
records.name: Apostate
records.unitInformation: This "Deep Sleeper"... Well, this classification no longer applies to her, as her attributes have surpassed those of all previously recorded Deep Sleepers. Her mutation extends beyond her mask, revealing woody tissues on her limbs and enhanced abilities that intensify the ferocity of her attacks. Her constant murmuring echoes like an omen of disaster, causing mental and physical torment for her opponents.\nWhat obsessive pursuit compels her to forsake all she once held dear?

records.name: Mumeika
records.safeInformation: A Night Chains member with exquisite martial skills. Attacks deal physical and Fire DMG, possessing a unique Migiri stance that, upon ending, delivers a powerful counterattack to enemies.
records.unitInformation: A skilled member of the Night Chains, he has forsaken conventional swords in favor of massive dual-bladed swords, aiming for unmatched attack performance and efficiency. Prioritizing lethality over the traditional Migiri art, he sometimes even harms his allies. When he finds an opening to counterattack, his fluid sword movements swiftly target his enemy's throat. Against him, impatience and complacency are equally fatal.

records.name: Alnitak
records.getCharacter: Hohoho! I am Yamaarashi, the future queen of the ninja world. Bear witness! Hahaha!

records.idCN: 01敌方/06深眠者/深眠者·沉溺/BOSS-深眠者·沉溺
records.name: DS: Immersed
records.safeInformation: A Deep Sleeper who has forsaken humanity, abandoning human weapons to become one with the Chaos Forest. Every branch is a part of her strength.
records.unitInformation: Her entire body is covered in armor made of wooden fibers, with her original mask expanding into a helmet that covers her entire head. Her muscles and bones have undergone severe distortions. The initial shock of seeing her may turn into nightly nightmares — if one survives that long.

records.name: Nicola

FoodList.letter: I just bought some random curry cubes, but don't worry, I added loads of potatoes, so it'll taste awesome.

records.birthdayMessage: I'm not a fan of cakes that are too sweet. This is perfectly bitter. Since it's a unique occasion, I'll make you a cup of coffee to go with it... It's only natural for me to show this degree of care toward someone who belongs to me.

ResumeList.des: Head of Anita Energy Institute, an expert in the fields of Chaos Stone and energy, and the inventor with the most patents in Anita. However, Nicola is not bothered by these titles, so she doesn't take action as the Head, doesn't attend research meetings, and even stuffs her patent applications into a safe, never to open them again. If she's spotted outside, it must be to pursue something truly close to her heart... such as newly released plush toys and new flavors of potato products, or indispensable research collaborators.

records.getCharacter: I'm Nicola. Fear not, these weapons are in non-lethal mode.

records.name: Barricade
records.safeInformation: A sturdy barricade that must be destroyed to proceed.
records.unitInformation: A sturdy barricade that must be destroyed to proceed.

records.name: Achiwa
records.safeInformation: An intern Gardener from Anita Energy Tech, dedicated to swiftly dealing with Chaos Stones with a single hammerfall, preferably in combat.

records.name: Yer
records.safeInformation: A gardener from Anita Energy Tech, controlling multiple drones to assist in both work and combat.

records.idCN: 01敌方/000角色/园丁/卡莱雅/卡莱雅
records.name: Kaleya
records.safeInformation: A gardener from Anita Energy Tech, her frequent travels to the Chaos Space haven't made her rusty in combat.

records.idCN: 01敌方/02桦树/山野/浑噩针蕈/浑噩针蕈
records.name: Chaos Gerris
records.safeInformation: A complexly structured Chaos Remain, possessing multiple attack methods. When threatened, it burrows into the ground to recover health and summons small clusters of bombardier beetles, launching self-destructive attacks at targets.
records.unitInformation: A more formidable Chaos Remain that requires at least a squad for direct engagement. With its complex armor and body structure, it employs various attack methods. When enraged, it enters a berserk state, greatly increasing its speed. It restores health by burrowing into the ground and summons small clusters of bombardier beetles underground, launching highly dangerous self-destructive attacks at targets.

records.idCN: 01敌方/02桦树/浮游/浮游/3D浮游-飞行1.5
records.name: Floating CR Remain

records.idCN: 01敌方/02桦树/浮游/浮游/3D浮游-飞行1.7
records.name: Floating CR Remain

records.idCN: 01敌方/02桦树/浮游/浮游/3D浮游-飞行1.1
records.name: Floating CR Remain
Akira

FoodList.letter: Looks flawless, tastes flawless. Go on, take it! A handsome genius makes it look easy in the kitchen too!

records.birthdayMessage: I went out of my way to pick a cake with a really striking design. This is the most sought-after fondant showpiece in the magazines, and next to impossible to get a reservation for!

ResumeList.des: Anita's most popular heartthrob, a striking fashion icon, a perfect, empathic genius, and a graceful skiing prince. Yes, this is Akira's... one-sided story. If you ask those who know him, you'd probably hear things like, "he's talented but always messes up at critical moments," "always concerned with looking cool in combat," and "honestly, he's a bit noisy"... comments that are far from glamorous and, according to Akira, totally uncool.

records.getCharacter: Ta-daaa~ Anita's most popular heartthrob, Akira, making his dazzling entrance!

records.idCN: 01敌方/09沙盗团/鸭子朱迪/鸭子朱迪
records.name: Jude
records.safeInformation: Jude, the right-hand of Shire. More than just a cute pet, she unleashes terrifying power on the battlefield.
records.unitInformation:
被夏尔称呼为朱迪的大鹅。除了种族天赋自带的啄技外，也掌握了一些令人感叹林子大了什么鹅都会有的特殊技能——虽然主要是因为夏尔的升构能力。杀伤力比农村用来看家护院的同类还要恐怖。
尽量别惹它，也别惹它的主人。

records.name: Caroline

FoodList.letter: I accidentally burnt it a bit while heating it up, but it should still be edible!

records.birthdayMessage: Although I don't really eat sweets, it's still good to have it once in a while! This cake was given out by the company. Come try it!

ResumeList.des: Pathfinder from Anita Energy Company, young and sharp-eyed, holding a flag-shaped exploration beacon, with a polite robot dog following behind. Compared to her mature and cautious partner, Caroline is livelier, though that's an understatement. From Yejue's complaints and helpless comments from other Anita employees, it's clear that Caroline trusts her first instinct over extensive planning and hours of waiting for instrument results. Maybe this is also a way of following her heart — Caroline's dream is to keep venturing into uncharted territories.

records.getCharacter: Hello, Conductor, I'm Caroline, Anita's Pathfinder. Nice to meet you!

records.name: Coldwave Bladder
records.safeInformation: Has the ability to change the surrounding climate, making the environment cold. Continuously applies Frost DMG and a stun effect to enemies. Increases DEF as HP decreases.
records.unitInformation: A perfect yet incomplete sphere, bouncing like a ball, extending tentacles like a balloon, it's a magnificent Chaos Remain. With special Chaos Glands, it can rapidly lower the surrounding temperature, even causing nearby areas to experience blizzards. Despite its beauty, it brings nothing but coldness, like neon lights shining in the snow.

records.name: Sand Phosphor
records.safeInformation: Can release immense energy to inflict reverengy DMG on enemies, and can resonate with the environment when in dust, immune to all negative effects.
records.unitInformation: This large-sized Chaos Remain presents a distinctive appearance resembling the skeleton of an animal. It poses a greater threat than regular Chaos Remains due to its brutal movements and the substantial energy it emits.\nIt deals Reverengy DMG to crew members. When it operates within sandy and dusty environments, it triggers a powerful resonance with the surroundings, making itself immune to all negative effects. However, this ability fails in rainy weather. It can also turn invisible and disengage through a molting process, resulting in the explosion of its original form and the birth of a Bony CR Remain. While in the bombardment mode, it unleashes a barrage of reverengy shells upon random targets.

records.idCN: 00我方/50未上线/03三星/神盾波克士
records.name: Box Aegis

FoodList.letter: Attempted recreation of a traditional Empire dessert, a flavor kids would like.

ResumeList.des: Leader of the little adventure party, a girl who takes on leadership responsibility, but seems the youngest among the group, looking only twelve or thirteen. She speaks in an unusually mature tone and carries herself like an experienced traveler and has the unquestioned trust of her party members. She always wears a fluffy white outfit regardless of the season, and somehow it neither gets dirty nor needs frequent changing. Sometimes, Arcana speaks in the tone reminiscent of an elderly, perhaps as a result of the strong influence of her elders?

records.getCharacter: My name is Arcana. Just a traveler you find anywhere.

records.idCN: 00我方/03三星/科伦巴/圣剑波克士
records.name: Box Excalibur

FoodList.letter: Sword-wielding arm lacks flexibility, resulting in poor heating conditions. Make sure to fix that up next time.

ResumeList.des: After modification, BOX is now called Box Excalibur (note: its weapon has no legendary tales). Equipped with a large melee weapon, the connection point is fortified to prevent the sword-shaped weapon from loosening or falling off, allowing flexible wielding in combat. Additionally, it has been upgraded with the latest Bionic Operator upgrade disk from the BCRL, enabling it to adapt to more complex battlefield environments and better assist in combat.

records.getCharacter: Bionic Operator X activated. Please select the voice profile for the android dialogue system from the settings.

records.name: NC Ninja
records.safeInformation: A common member of Night Chains, adept at throwing shurikens with agility and launching sudden attacks from stealth.
records.unitInformation: A common member of Night Chains, adept at throwing shurikens with agility and launching sudden attacks from stealth.

records.name: NC Voltgun
records.safeInformation: A common member of the Night Chains. His firearm can launch electromagnetic shells, dealing DMG to multiple targets and inflicting Electrify effects.
records.unitInformation: A common member of the Night Chains. For some reason, he's dressed in white and appears somewhat unique. His specially modified firearm can launch electromagnetic shells, dealing DMG to multiple targets and inflicting Electrify effects.

records.idCN: 00我方/09召唤物/晃/液氮喷洒装置
records.name: Liquid Nitrogen Sprayer
Raimei
records.safeInformation: A skilled member of the Night Chains, whose Electrify effects from his attacks can effectively draw enemy attention. His excellent defense makes him a formidable opponent.
records.unitInformation: A skilled member of the Night Chains who has abandoned standard weapons, instead wielding a specially modified electromagnetic force field sword and shield. This combination achieves a perfect balance between offense and defense. The sword and shield's excellent Electrify effects greatly restrict enemy movement. Additionally, after energy storage is complete, the shield releases a large-scale electromagnetic attack. With superb defensive capabilities, once given a chance to catch his breath, he becomes even more formidable. Don't linger in battle!

records.name: Haruka
records.battleDes: The BCRL assigns technicians to each train based on demand and assessment. All crew members are required to train in combat with these technicians... But why does Haruka's training record bear the number "1000"?
records.safeInformation: The technician of The Eternal, (one of) the authorities in charge of the carriages. She must be quickly returned to the carriage after combat.

records.name: Sandarmor
records.safeInformation: A Chaos Remain with a reptilian appearance, able to cause Reverengy DMG. It can reduce damage for itself and allies and remove their Ignite effects.
records.unitInformation: A Chaos Remain with a reptilian appearance, able to cause  Reverengy DMG. It gathers nearby sand particles to threaten crew members and protect itself. It can also throw energy bombs to remove the Ignite effects from its fellow Chaos Remains and provide them with shields.

records.name: Sandgrub
records.safeInformation: A Chaos Remain with an insect-like appearance, able to cause Reverengy DMG. It can dodge attacks and restore the HP of other Chaos Remains.
records.unitInformation: A Chaos Remain with an insect-like appearance, able to cause Reverengy DMG. Its unique body structure allows it to leap and evade attacks, as well as restore the HP of other Chaos Remains.

records.name: Floating Phosphor
records.safeInformation: A Chaos Remain with a flying insect-like appearance, able to cause Reverengy DMG in a large area with various attack methods. It can also make other Chaos Remains Berserk.
records.unitInformation: A Chaos Remain with a flying insect-like appearance, able to cause Reverengy DMG in a large area with various attack methods. Additionally, it can damage other Chaos Remains and make them Berserk.

records.idCN: 01敌方/06深眠者/深眠者·迷痴-盾锤
records.name: DS: Bewitched
records.safeInformation: A Deep Sleeper clad in Anita's uniform, who can cause Reverengy DMG after charging up its defense. He can also heal himself and dispel his own negative effects.
records.unitInformation: Clad in Anita Energy Tech uniform, this Deep Sleeper may have once been an explorer of the chaos space. Wielding a heavy shield and hammer, he boasts excellent defense and healing abilities. The bandage-like tissue wrapped around his body seems to be the main conduit for his healing abilities, so his status should be monitored closely.

records.idCN: 01敌方/06深眠者/深眠者·迷愚-斧子
records.name: DS: Bewildered
records.safeInformation: A Deep Sleeper clad in Anita's uniform, whose attacks can deal Physical or Reverengy DMG. Some attacks may cause a Slash effect.
records.unitInformation: Clad in Anita Energy Tech uniform, this Deep Sleeper may have once been an explorer of the Chaos Space. Wielding a simple yet practical hand axe, he sometimes launches spinning attacks to cause Reverengy DMG to targets within a certain range. He seems capable of tossing the axe into the air and using it to slash the ground.

records.idCN: 01敌方/12发电站/阿妮塔武装守卫
records.name: Anita Armed Guard
records.safeInformation: A Guard equipped with Anita's standard protective gear, capable of deploying an energy shield and causing area damage with a Stun effect.
records.unitInformation: A guard equipped with Anita's standard protective gear, often found near Anita's facilities. His short staff can deploy an energy shield around him and cause area damage with a Stun effect during attacks.

records.idCN: 01敌方/12发电站/阿妮塔武装哨卫-后排
records.name: Anita Armed Sentinel
records.safeInformation: A guard equipped with Anita's standard protective gear, capable of deploying an energy shield with a long staff and inflicting a Break effect.
records.unitInformation: A guard equipped with Anita's standard protective gear, often found near Anita's facilities. His long staff can deploy an energy shield and cause area damage with a Break effect.

records.name: CR: Marine
records.safeInformation: A Chaos Remain that thrives in aquatic environments. Its Basic Attacks have a chance to Chill targets. It poses a high threat as it can deal area damage in various ways.
records.unitInformation: A Chaos Remain that thrives in damp environments and water. Its normal ranged attacks have a chance to Chill and Confuse targets. It inflicts damage to all crew members based on the number of Chilled targets. Additionally, it launches large-scale attacks to remove Chill effects from crew members, dealing significant Reverengy DMG.

records.name: Chaos Behemoth
records.safeInformation: This entity deals both melee Physical DMG and area Reverb DMG. It also curses its enemies and shatters their shields. Keep in mind that it deals increased Reverb DMG as its HP decreases.
records.unitInformation: A towering Chaos Remain prone to sudden fits of rage. Its intricately armored exterior boasts exceptional strength. Even in a calm state, its strikes and stomps are formidable, posing significant threats. When enraged, it becomes even deadlier, unleashing devastating attacks. The horn on its head can harness reverberation energies to afflict various debuffs on the target or even render them unconscious.

records.idCN: 01敌方/02桦树/海龙/凛川骨龙/BOSS-凛川骨龙头
records.name: Glacial Skeleton
records.safeInformation: This CR: Marine releases powerful frost attacks. It inflicts a variety of debuffs including Chill, Fetter, and Stun, and it releases "Dragon Might" that reduces DMG taken. It summons glaciers that strike multiple targets simultaneously.
records.unitInformation: This large-sized Chaos Remain showcases an exoskeleton resembling a bone dragon, although it is not related to actual "dragons" at all. It possesses the unique ability to conjure phantoms resembling its own form, while its resonating chamber produces resounding roars that reverberate through the sky. In the face of this creature, one can understand why it earns the moniker "dragon," as its breath and power rival those found in fictional tales.\nIt inflicts a variety of debuffs including [Chill], [Fetter], and [Imprison], and it casts "Dragon Might" that reduces DMG taken. Additionally, it summons glaciers that strike multiple targets simultaneously and has a chance to inflict [Chill], and its powerful attacks can shatter the target's [Shield].

records.idCN: 01敌方/02桦树/海龙/凛川骨龙/BOSS-凛川骨龙尾
records.name: Glacial Skeleton
CR: Jawfish
records.safeInformation: A Chaos Remain that thrives in aquatic environments. Its Basic Attacks have a chance to Chill targets. It emits special sound waves that can remove Freeze effects from targets and deal additional damage.
records.unitInformation: A Chaos Remain that thrives in damp environments and water. Its normal melee attacks have a chance to Chill targets. It emits special sound waves that, upon contact with frozen targets, remove their Freeze effects and deal additional damage.

records.name: CR: Seahorse
records.safeInformation: A Chaos Remain that thrives in aquatic environments. Its Basic Attacks have a chance to Chill targets. It also has the ability to turn invisible.
records.unitInformation: A Chaos Remain that thrives in damp environments and water. Its normal ranged attacks have a chance to Chill targets. Occasionally, it can briefly turn invisible, making it untargetable during that time.

records.name: CR: Crowned Seahorse
records.safeInformation: A Chaos Remain that thrives in aquatic environments. It attacks by spitting foam, causing damage and inflicting a Chill effect. The foam can also share damage with other enemies and has the ability to turn Chill into Confuse.
records.unitInformation: A Chaos Remain that thrives in damp environments and water. It attacks by spitting foam. The foam splits into several parts after causing damage and inflicting a Chill effect, further damaging and Chilling other targets. It can also heal enemy targets and grant them immunity to one hit of damage. It can summon clusters of small Chaos Remains from its chest, turn Chill into Confuse.

records.name: Timbersaw
records.safeInformation: Old-fashioned operational machinery that emits cold air to inflict Frost DMG and inflict [Chill] effect. DEF gradually decreases over time, but DMG increases.
records.unitInformation:
无论从时代还是环境角度考虑都不应该出现在此地的作业用机械。
这架伐木机械应该是曾经服役于“北方阵线”的型号。虽只是伐木机械，但其破坏力不可小觑；另外，其上加装的降温模块似乎有些出力过猛，因此经常出现锯末和冰屑同飞的效果。在“北阵”解散多年后的现在，北方阵线的机械现身于此的原因，还是个谜。

records.name: MOM
records.safeInformation: A Deep Sleeper roaming on the stranded freighter in the wilderness. She has begun to enter a deeper state of slumber, which is extremely dangerous but does not seem to actively attack humans.
records.unitInformation:
在荒原地区的搁浅巨轮上游荡的深眠者，已开始进入深眠者的下一阶段，非人外形中残留的一些服饰特征勉强还能分辨出其来历。
与一般深眠者不同，只在船只的某些固定区域内徘徊。因其行动十分规律，稍加注意就可以避开冲突，似乎并没有主动攻击人类的意思。她是为何仍存于此世呢？
能对我方角色造成“心魔共鸣”标记，每隔一定时间造成伤害。蓄力后，可通过挥爪动作引爆我方的“心魔共鸣”标记。制造的幻影与本体能力相同，会与幻影一同行动，释放强大的全体攻击。

records.idCN: 01敌方/06深眠者/深眠者·迷梦/BOSS-深眠者·迷梦
records.name: DS: Dreamy
records.safeInformation: An inexplicably familiar Deep Sleeper. Deals DMG by inflicting "Devil Inside Consonance" and detonating it, and can create mirror images to act alongside her.
records.unitInformation:
于形态污染严重地区出现的深眠者，不知为何散发出令人怀念的气息……据部分目击报告声称，见到此类深眠者“就像是看见了妈妈的身影一样”。该现象可能与其制造幻影的能力有关。
能对我方角色造成“心魔共鸣”标记，每隔一定时间造成伤害。蓄力后，可通过挥爪动作引爆我方的“心魔共鸣”标记。制造的幻影与本体能力相同，会与幻影一同行动，释放强大的全体攻击。

records.unitInformation: A grotesquely shaped Chaos Remain that possesses the ability to reflect incoming damage, owing to its makeshift armor. While naming this formidable creature, researchers encountered some controversy regarding the naming rules for Chaos Remains...\nIts attacks inflict various negative effects including [Slash], [Scorch], and [Interrupt]. Its skill [Rampant Ripples] deals Reverengy DMG while inflicting [Berserk] or [Confuse], and drains energy from crew members based on the number of crew members under [Berserk] effect. It can assume a defensive stance by curling up. While in this state, whenever it takes a certain number of hits, it gains a stack of Fury, reducing its DEF and increasing its ATK. When it accumulates a certain number of Fury stacks or when its defensive stance expires, it deals Reverengy DMG to all crew members based on the Fury stacks and inflicts [Injure].

ResumeList.des: A member of the P.U.S., her origin, Ascension Ability, and true identity are shrouded in mystery. Typically, she would be classified as a potential threat and subject to permanent surveillance. However, due to her exceptional contribution in resolving an incident involving the Eternal CBCRR23 train crew, she has been temporarily designated as part of the crew's support staff and granted licensed crew member access. As she may not possess full civil capacity yet, the rest of the crew is encouraged to exercise tolerance and supervise her conduct to support her healthy development.

records.getCharacter: Ah! That terrifying Conductor! Why are you here?! ...Oh, I got it! You're submitting to the mighty Lord Shire, right?

records.safeInformation: The leader of the looters armed with a multi-purpose wheel saw. This enemy can deal Electro and Fire DMG, as well as inflict various negative effects. When taking lethal DMG, this unit triggers Eternal Spark.
records.unitInformation: The leader of the looters, equipped with exceptional external armor and possesses a strong determination to engage in combat. Compared to other looters, his armor is even more prominently exaggerated. The weapon he wields is a modified Chaos Stone mining device manufactured by Anita. His primary attack method involves using his multi-purpose wheel saw to strike multiple targets. When the wheel saw is spinning at high speeds, it launches impact bolts that deal Electro DMG to all crew members and Electrify them. When used as a melee weapon, the wheel saw deals Fire DMG to crew members and launches them into mid air, with a chance of Igniting them.\nEternal Spark: When taking lethal DMG, this unit becomes Invincible, fully restores his HP, and inflicts Inferno on the entire battlefield. While under the effect of Eternal Spark, the unit is immune to all control effects and casts skills more frequently, but loses HP over time. This effect can be triggered up to 3 times, with the amount of HP restoration decreasing each time.

It inflicts a variety of negative effects including Chill, Fetter, and Stun, and it releases Dragon Might that reduces incoming DMG taken. Additionally, it summons glaciers that strike multiple targets simultaneously. Its frequent and powerful attacks make it a formidable opponent.
records.unitInformation: A variant of Glacial Skeleton, originating from an unknown source. Some scholars propose that it split from a single Glacial Skeleton, while others argue that it is a chimera formed by multiple dragons attempting to devour each other.\nIt inflicts a variety of negative effects including Chill, Fetter, and Imprison, and it releases Dragon Might that reduces incoming DMG taken. Additionally, it summons glaciers that strike multiple targets simultaneously and may Chill them, and its powerful attacks can shatter the target's shield. Compared to regular bone dragons, this variant exhibits a higher frequency of attacks, thus making it a more formidable enemy.

records.unitInformation: This Deep Sleeper has undergone severe corruption due to morphic field pollution, resulting in extensive mutation of his body tissues resembling a Chaos Remain structure. Rumors suggest that he once served as a jailer in a remote prison, and now he still grips his chains.\nWhenever you use a card, Chainbane Jailer gains Energy. Chainbane Jailer marks crew members, and marks can be removed by using cards. Remaining marks will deal DMG after a period of time. When a mark fails to trigger, Chainbane Jailer enters [Hunger] state and marks an additional target.

records.name: Heinrich

FoodList.letter: A simple, homemade dish that provides nourishment. Enjoy it while it is still hot.

records.birthdayMessage: I bought the bestseller from the cake shop near my house. It should taste pretty good. Don't forget to share it with the rest of the train crew.

ResumeList.des: Before visiting the BCRL Agency in Shoggolith City, one can easily discover Heinrich's reputation by pointing to the renowned BCRL recruitment poster and asking, "Ohh! Who's that?" The question would yield various responses. Some would identify him as the head of the BCRL Agency in Shoggolith City, while others would describe him as a war hero and a model soldier from the old days. However, upon meeting this living legend in person, one would be impressed by his down-to-earth attitude, as well as the restraint and friendliness commonly found in a typical soldier, as he is always ready to extend help as part of his duty.

records.getCharacter: I'm Heinrich, administrator of Shoggolith's BCRL Agency. Temporarily staying on the Eternal. I'm sure you need no further introduction, considering the mutual trust we have.

records.name: Thunderstorm Bug
records.safeInformation: A variant of Primal Chaos Remain that shares similarities with Blastbugs in physiology. It deals Electro DMG to enemies in the target area and displays remarkable resilience. Upon taking lethal DMG, it remains on the battle for a period of time.
records.unitInformation: A variant of Primal Chaos Remain that shares similarities with Blastbugs in physiology but features a distinct shell composition. It launches more potent Electro attacks against enemies in the target area and displays even greater resilience. Upon taking lethal DMG, it remains on the battle for a period of time.

records.name: CR: Reverse
records.safeInformation: An Origin CR primarily using electro attacks, can trigger Electro DMG in multiple ways and also generate a shield that reflects damage. Its Morphic Field differs from that of regular CRs.
records.unitInformation: A highly threatening CR, an advanced life form of Origin CR, has a Morphic Field that is distinct from that of common CRs. Other characteristics remain to be studied—currently, the only known information is that this type of CR is closely related to the Morphic Moon at its origin.\nIts attacks have a chance to trigger the Electrify effect and can slightly restore its own HP; it can consume its own HP to generate a counter-damage shield, ensuring that its next attack will definitely trigger the corresponding Status effect. Additionally, it can create a large electromagnetic field, with a certain probability of inflicting the [Magnetize] effect on enemies within the area.

records.unitInformation: A member of the Fluffy Union, this over-sized plush doll appears menacing, especially when one realizes that a human operator resides within. It hurls syringes to curse foes and heal allies, occasionally imprisoning targets with its attacks.

records.name: Tennie

FoodList.letter: Ahhh, who needs all that fuss with cooking! Just heat it up, and we're good to go, right?

records.birthdayMessage: I wanted a teddy bear styled one, but sadly, they didn't have that option... This one tastes great, though!

ResumeList.des: Anyone who frequently visits the Mander Mine's Train Weapon Factory is bound to remember the girl with golden hair. Her striking long golden hair—far too vivid for the soot-stained technicians of the rail industry—along with bold streaks of color, flamboyant and avant-garde fashion, and a voice that carries without effort, all make Tennie an unmistakable presence and something of a living signboard for the Train Weapon Factory. And yet, she is also its top engineer. With a single call, she can be found emerging from piles of tools and half-assembled machinery, ready to solve any problem a visiting conductor might bring.

records.getCharacter: I'm Tennie. I look forward to working with you from now on. ...Can you get a discount for train armament? That's not for me to decide!

records.name: Vortex Eye
records.safeInformation: Can inflict a variety of elemental attributes and DMG, prioritizing attacks with attributes different from the negative effects on the character. The Morphic Field differs from the general CR, and it can reduce the DMG received to a certain extent.
records.unitInformation: The CR with a powerful threat, an advanced life form of Origin CR, has a Morphic Field different from that of general CRs. Other characteristics are yet to be studied—currently, the only known fact is that this type of CR is closely related to its origin on the Morphic Moon; however, according to other research reports, it seems the Empire also has legends about similar "monsters"...\nThe Vortex Eye can target the enemy's weaknesses and even increase corresponding attribute output when it receives certain attribute DMG. Thanks to this characteristic, it poses a great threat to squads, enough to destroy an entire team in an instant.

records.name: Electro Needle
records.safeInformation: This Primal Chaos Remain Electrifies its targets and triggers Thunder. Additionally, it activates Thunder Flare, enhancing the DMG dealt by other Primal CR.
records.unitInformation: Known as the "lightning rod" by Cape City residents, this Primal Chaos Remain Electrifies its targets and triggers Thunder. Additionally, it activates Thunder Flare, enhancing the DMG dealt by other Primal CR. This entity protects other Chaos Remains, absorbing their incoming damage. When it takes lethal DMG from damage sharing, it activates Thunder Flare to strengthen its allies.

records.safeInformation: A formidable Deep Sleeper bearing a striking resemblance to a legendary swordsman from the Empire's lore. This entity formulates strategies based on the quantity of Red and Blue hand cards. Its sword waves can deal massive damage and inflict debuffs.
records.unitInformation: This formidable Deep Sleeper, with most of its body tissues mutated, bears a resemblance to a long-haired warrior from the legends of the Mundus Empire. In the conclusion of the legend, the warrior, having lost everything, self-exiled from the homeland.\nAt the start of battle, it examines the number of in your hand, the deck and the discard pile and adjust stance accordingly. If there are more Red cards, it adopts a defensive stance, becoming immune to crowd-control effects and taking less damage. In addition, Red cards have their cost reduced when drawn, while other cards have their cost increased. If there are more Blue cards, it adopts an offensive stance and deals more damage. In addition, Blue cards have their cost reduced when drawn, while other cards have their cost increased. If the numbers of Red and Blue cards are equal or at 0, it adopts a balanced stance. In this case, its attacks deal additional True DMG, and all cards have their cost randomized when drawn.\nIt unleashes potent sword waves and inflicts various debuffs including [Scorch] and [Slash].
