records.unitInformation: A large-sized countermeasure machine devised by the Destroyer of Citadel, codename "Enni." Its actions are controlled by a capsule-shaped countermeasure system located at the rear upper part and can receive remote commands.\nEquipped with various special weapons, it can inflict multiple negative effects, including [Knockback], [Imprison], [Fetter], and [Confuse]. It can also deal significant DMG to all allies through its flame jet device. Each time it receives Physical DMG, the amount of all DMG it takes is reduced. FoodList.letter: Theoretically, it is edible.

records.birthdayMessage: Dark chocolate has been proven beneficial for maintaining human health. Please prioritize your overall well-being and try to minimize visits to the medical room.

ResumeList.des: The Ascension faction is a cardinal academic faction of Source Citadel, but in comparison with their colleagues, the Ascension's researchers seem to be even more radical when it comes to means and viewpoints. By the standards of society, they are without a doubt unscrupulous. As a scholar in this faction, Ithos doesn't exactly have an amiable demeanor, which makes it understandable why he isn't well-liked by others. Still, there are some unsettling rumors that surround him - a researcher who used his family as lab rats, an amoral, horrifying murderer... But he has never once responded to these accusations.

records.getCharacter: I'm Ithos. You have a lot of specimens on your train worth collecting. Not allowed? It's all right. I'll earn your approval eventually.

records.name: Slayer: Chainsaw
records.safeInformation: Leader of Slayers possessing Ascension Abilities. He deals Physical DMG and area Reverb DMG. In addition, he inflicts [Crack] on your cards, causing the user to suffer damage. This effect can be nullified by using [Crack] cards.
records.unitInformation:
One of the Slayer's leaders, clad in armor fashioned from rugby protective gear, stands tall with a faceplate concealing his visage... Could he have fallen to morphic field pollution?
Most of his attacks deal Physical DMG. His Ascension Ability enables him to deal Reverb DMG within a large area and [Stuns] his targets.
Whenever a card enters your deck, he inflicts a stack of [Crack] on it, stacking up to 3 times. Whenever a card with [Crack] is drawn, it deals DMG to the card owner based on the [Crack] stacks. Using a card with [Crack] removes a stack.
After the [Crack] effect deals DMG 30 times, he immediately unleashes his Ultimate skill, dealing Physical DMG to all enemies once and inflicting [Slash]. In addition, triggers all [Crack] effects on all of your cards.
Upon taking lethal DMG for the first time, he becomes [Invincible] for 10 seconds. After that, each time he deals DMG, he restores a large amount of HP. This effect lasts the rest of the battle.

records.unitInformation: A versatile mecha left over from the Earth Union era, its design and manufacturing styles reflect the characteristics of that time. While the B.C.R.L. has become the dominant power, some power mechas are still in use, while others have been abandoned or resold for various reasons. One such power mecha fell into the hands of an ambitious marauder, who gave it a fancy name "The Wilderness King." However, this document refers to it as the "Power Driller."\nIt is equipped with powerful firearms that launch charged attacks, striking and stunning the target. Additionally, it can unleash drill attacks after breaking any crew member's shield, dealing DMG to the target and inflicting Injure.

FoodList.letter: My mom taught me how to cook before~ When you're free, show me your cooking skills too, Conductor!

records.birthdayMessage: Ballie doesn't know how to bake cakes, so she bought one from the store! It's going to be delicious! Enjoy it, Conductor!

ResumeList.des: This document certifies that Pelota (born on September 5, ■■■■, adult) currently holds the position of Special Agent within Gardener. She has been a regular employee of our organization for the past two consecutive years. Effective immediately, Pelota is designated as a crew member aboard the Eternal for a period of ■■ days. During her assignment, she will comply with the laws and regulations of bonfire cities and the Eternal. We undertake to indemnify her against any accidental damages within the scope of the contract. The terms of this arrangement are detailed in the document titled "Memorandum on Matters Concerning Pelota's Special Dispatch."

records.getCharacter: I'm Pelota, but you can call me Ballie if you'd like to! I'm pretty awesome and definitely useful!... Oh, by the way, are all the electronic devices on your train insured?

records.name: HowlingBox
records.safeInformation: A type of "Metaplasia." It can summon various weapons to attack and emits an earth-shattering roar. Defeating it grants abundant rewards.
records.unitInformation: A type of Metaplasia known as HowlingBox, perhaps named from its distinctive roar, or its box shape, or both.\nThis Metaplasia boasts superior combat prowess compared to its lesser counterparts, capable of extracting more weapons from within. Despite its adorable appearance, it presents a grave challenge for conductors, yet the rewards for defeating it are irresistible.

records.name: Miss Gold

FoodList.letter: Gold diggers used to love this dessert most. It's sweet! Gold made it!

records.birthdayMessage: A cake golden like dreams! Sweet, delicious. Humans love sweet, right?

ResumeList.des: An old nugget mech model manufactured around 25 years ago that used to serve ONEderland and its surrounding areas. Primarily in charge of the other nugget mechs' work as a whole. Owing to her adorable appearance, she was widely celebrated as "Miss Gold" by the workers during the gold rush. Although ONEderland fell into decline for two decades, she continued maintaining the operation of the station and its nearby facilities. Her components and exterior are in various degrees of disrepair due to her excessive length of service and perpetual exposure to morphic field pollution. After undergoing partial maintenance and upgrading, she is now working as a crew member on The Eternal as a COLUMBA employee.

records.getCharacter: I'm Gold. What? Know me? But this, first meet. ...Just joking! Yes. I learn, jokes, Conductor. Happy, be your friend.

records.name: Mumei

ResumeList.des: A mysterious girl claiming to have come from "Koutetsujou". During the events occurred near Ranshin City, numerous people witnessed her combat ability no weaker to that of an Ascender, but her identity, background, and the truth behind her ability remain a mystery. At present, Mumei is temporarily traveling with the Eternal while searching for a way to return to her train.

records.getCharacter: I'm Mumei, temporarily serving as a bodyguard here. Ah, payment won't be necessary. Just provide me with adequate food and a place to sleep.

records.unitInformation: A highly threatening CR, an advanced life form of Origin CR, with a Morphic Field that differs from that of general CRs. Other characteristics are yet to be studied—currently, the only known fact is that this type of CR is closely related to the Morphic Moon at its origin.\nAttacks have a chance to inflict [Chill] on your crew and can summon a large area of blizzard. Additionally, it can generate a curtain like the aurora in front of itself, reducing the DMG it takes and blocking all Frost DMG.

records.name: Raziel The Reminisce

FoodList.letter: I added some spicy curry. It's great for a simple meal. How about we have some fried chicken next time?

records.birthdayMessage: Confluence Tower special cake! Well, I made it myself following the recipe. Thanks for bringing me the ingredients earlier. Want to have a taste? It's really good!

ResumeList.des: Raziel, a mentor of Source Citadel. Used to be the resident mentor aboard the airship Senanonic. In recent years, she volunteered to become the guardian of entity SC-002 (commonly known as "Jalhay"). From then on, to ensure the safety and stability of SC-002, she and SC-002 moved to the Confluence Tower. On account of her stellar reputation within Source Citadel, her living and research environments were specially retained in recognition of her contribution. May Raziel complete her guardianship duties toward SC-002 as swiftly as possible, alongside her relevant research, and return to Senanonic soon.

records.getCharacter: I am Raziel. Though I'm not sure what exactly I can do on the Eternal... I hope I can at least lessen the burden on your shoulders a little.

records.unitInformation: An immensely powerful Primal Chaos entity featuring a towering form. Upon its arrival, dark clouds envelop the sky, leading to localized weather changes, although its exact purpose remains a mystery.\nThe Nether Envoy can manipulate the battlefield environment, adjusting its abilities and damage types accordingly. While in the Radiance Ritual environment, it deals Electro DMG and increases the card costs in your hand. While in the Darkness Ritual environment, it deals Reverengy DMG, reduces the card costs in your hand, and heals your characters. In addition, it possesses skills that reduce Final DMG taken, and when afflicted by debuffs, it sacrifices its HP to nullify them. Please note that its skills inflict various debuffs and deal massive damage to all your characters.

records.unitInformation: Breaking through Kabane's outer shell unveils the core of "Kuro Keburi", Aoba, once a familiar face now transformed into a mutant with a heart of steel. To save her and everything she holds dear...\nShe can summon a tornado that strikes in a large area and reduces your ATK. She generates the card [Corrosion] in your hand, and when the cost of [Corrosion] is reduced to 0, the corroded character will become unable to cast any skills. You will need to play [Corrosion] to dispel this debuff. Note that [Corrosion] cannot be played when Ironhearted Aoba channels her ultimate skill Ogi: Arashi.

records.name: Slayer: Chainsaw
records.safeInformation: Leader of Slayers possessing Ascension Abilities. He deals Physical DMG and area Reverb DMG. In addition, he inflicts [Crack] on your cards, causing the user to suffer damage. This effect can be nullified by using [Crack] cards.
records.unitInformation:
One of the Slayer's leaders, clad in armor fashioned from rugby protective gear, stands tall with a faceplate concealing his visage... Could he have fallen to morphic field pollution?
Most of his attacks deal Physical DMG. His Ascension Ability enables him to deal Reverb DMG within a large area and [Stuns] his targets.
Whenever a card enters your deck, he inflicts a stack of [Crack] on it, stacking up to 3 times. Whenever a card with [Crack] is drawn, it deals DMG to the card owner based on the [Crack] stacks. Using a card with [Crack] removes a stack.
After the [Crack] effect deals DMG 30 times, he immediately unleashes his Ultimate skill, dealing Physical DMG to all enemies once and inflicting [Slash]. In addition, triggers all [Crack] effects on all of your cards.
Upon taking lethal DMG for the first time, he becomes [Invincible] for 10 seconds. After that, each time he deals DMG, he restores a large amount of HP. This effect lasts the rest of the battle.

records.unitInformation: This Deep Sleeper has undergone severe corruption due to morphic field pollution, resulting in extensive mutation of his body tissues resembling a Chaos Remain structure. Rumors suggest that he once served as a jailer in a remote prison, and now he still grips his chains.\nWhenever you use a card, Chainbane Jailer gains Energy. Chainbane Jailer marks crew members, and marks can be removed by using cards. Remaining marks will deal DMG after a period of time. When a mark fails to trigger, Chainbane Jailer enters [Hunger] state and marks an additional target.

ResumeList.des: Failed Angel entity, "Ushana." Has been known to lose control multiple times and is hence determined to be a highly dangerous entity. However, as she has remained virtually lucid in recent years, she is specially approved to be deployed as an ordinary Citadel member. During the LRA-00 incident, this entity exhibited extraordinary admiration and devotion toward CBCRR23 The Eternal's conductor, thus leading to a series of consequences, including damage to the restriction system, but the matter did not negatively affect the entity's state of mind. After the incident, the entity passed basic stability tests and received special approval to stay on CBCRR23 The Eternal, on the condition that she put on specific equipment and kept the SOAP system activated at all times.

records.getCharacter: The adventure story of me and my Master Savior is about to begin!

records.name: Raziel

FoodList.letter: I've tried... Let me know if it doesn't taste right...

records.birthdayMessage: Thanks for embracing the new me... Let's treasure the time we have ahead together.

ResumeList.des: Failed Angel entity, Raziel. Determined to be a failed transformation subject during LRA-00 and precipitated a ■-level incident and a series of dangerous events within Haima Zaria. However, with the efforts of CBCRR23 the Eternal's conductor and Source Citadel members who made it in time, LRA-00 was successfully resolved and did not cause any additional casualties. As this entity was once a Source Citadel mentor and is acquainted with CBCRR23 the Eternal's conductor, she has received special approval to stay on the Eternal, provided her mental state remains stable, and to be kept under observation and accept regular treatments.

records.getCharacter: I'm Raziel. That's what they told me. It seems I have caused you trouble before, though I no longer remember it...

records.safeInformation: The leader of the looters armed with a multi-purpose wheel saw. This enemy can deal Electro and Fire DMG, as well as inflict various negative effects. When taking lethal DMG, this unit triggers Eternal Spark.
records.unitInformation: The leader of the looters, equipped with exceptional external armor and possesses a strong determination to engage in combat. Compared to other looters, his armor is even more prominently exaggerated. The weapon he wields is a modified Chaos Stone mining device manufactured by Anita. His primary attack method involves using his multi-purpose wheel saw to strike multiple targets. When the wheel saw is spinning at high speeds, it launches impact bolts that deal Electro DMG to all crew members and Electrify them. When used as a melee weapon, the wheel saw deals Fire DMG to crew members and launches them into mid air, with a chance of Igniting them.\nEternal Spark: When taking lethal DMG, this unit becomes Invincible, fully restores his HP, and inflicts Inferno on the entire battlefield. While under the effect of Eternal Spark, the unit is immune to all control effects and casts skills more frequently, but loses HP over time. This effect can be triggered up to 3 times, with the amount of HP restoration decreasing each time.

records.unitInformation: A mysterious sword-shaped CR resembling the "Golden Crow" from Eastern Continent legends, leading some researchers to consider it as evidence that the form of CR is related to the human collective unconsciousness. However, due to insufficient data, this theory has not been verified to date.\nIt switches between the [Blazing Sun] Status, primarily using electro abilities, and the [Solar Flame] Status, primarily using fire abilities, causing different type of DMG and skill effects.

records.safeInformation: A formidable Deep Sleeper bearing a striking resemblance to a legendary swordsman from the Empire's lore. This entity formulates strategies based on the quantity of Red and Blue hand cards. Its sword waves can deal massive damage and inflict debuffs.
records.unitInformation: This formidable Deep Sleeper, with most of its body tissues mutated, bears a resemblance to a long-haired warrior from the legends of the Mundus Empire. In the conclusion of the legend, the warrior, having lost everything, self-exiled from the homeland.\nAt the start of battle, it examines the number of in your hand, the deck and the discard pile and adjust stance accordingly. If there are more Red cards, it adopts a defensive stance, becoming immune to crowd-control effects and taking less damage. In addition, Red cards have their cost reduced when drawn, while other cards have their cost increased. If there are more Blue cards, it adopts an offensive stance and deals more damage. In addition, Blue cards have their cost reduced when drawn, while other cards have their cost increased. If the numbers of Red and Blue cards are equal or at 0, it adopts a balanced stance. In this case, its attacks deal additional True DMG, and all cards have their cost randomized when drawn.\nIt unleashes potent sword waves and inflicts various debuffs including [Scorch] and [Slash].

records.name: Gold Noget
records.unitInformation: A type of Metaplasia. Commonly known as Gold Noget. Nothing can move faster than light. If there has to be one, then it'll be the price fluctuation of gold!\nIt deals Electro DMG and inflicts powerful DMG effects.

ResumeList.des: A tall wolf demi-human with an outgoing and straightforward personality. Even among the BCRL Agency, where soldiers are generally of outstanding quality, Lycagia stands out for his exceptional physical fitness and combat abilities. By fully leveraging the superior physical qualities of a demi-human, he has achieved remarkable results in both team-led and solo combat operations. Additionally, through years of work at the BCRL Agency, he has gained extensive experience dealing with various forces. When encountering problems that are difficult to solve independently, one can confidently seek his assistance.

records.getCharacter: Lycagia reporting in! Starting today, I'm officially one of the Eternal crew. As for the reason... Heh, I'll tell you another day. Looking forward to the work here, Conductor!

ResumeList.des: As an executor of Night Chains and the owner of "Pupil's Fashion", Margiela has gained recognition and trust from everyone in various roles. She no longer needs to play the idealized role she once craved, for she has truly become a witch herself. Still, this never means she abandons her fondness for role-playing. The touching warmth she brings to others by briefly embodying different characters and making them real is a miracle that even magic can never replace.

ResumeList.des: As the Conductor and BCRL members well know, towing car driving stands among the most grueling of all road duties within BCRL. Even under the semi-compulsory assignment system, this line of work rarely finds many eager volunteers—for who, after all, would willingly choose to endure such long stretches of solitude, only to shoulder work so tedious and so fraught with danger? Against such a backdrop, Komugi's arrival was like a ray of golden, fragrant sunlight; wherever her furry little face appeared, every hardship and peril seemed, somehow, to simply melt away. So the next time you find yourself stranded or broken down out in the wilds, be sure to call for towing car driver Komugi over the comms!

records.getCharacter: Conductor, it's me, Komugi—no wait, I'm not here to drive the towing car today! Ahem! Starting today, I'm officially crew on the Eternal! Nice to meet you!

ResumeList.des: A mysterious member of the Verdant Realm Alliance who's come a long way from the Empire. From her first day aboard the Eternal, the curiosity and quiet inquiries about who she is have never let up. Her appearance marks her plainly as a citizen of the Empire— a Reverberater, even— and her combat ability is beyond belief, yet almost no one else from the Empire knows anything of her past. Every piece of information about her is classified at the Eternal's highest security level, and those cleared to read it can be counted on one hand... and you are the only one here who has witnessed her true form.

records.getCharacter: Ikara, here as the representative of the Verdant Realm Alliance and a future conductor in training. ...Someone told me that at school you call those who graduated before you "senior"... Am I to call you that as well?

ResumeList.des: A renowned researcher of Metaphysical Particles, a key member of Anita Tech's Second Division — the "Gardeners" — and a mentor besides. No small number of the younger generation among the Gardeners have benefited from his guidance and support, and the students he has trained himself have steadily become mainstays of one research project after another. Contrary to what his youthful, handsome appearance suggests, he has in fact already reached middle age. He joined Anita years ago, back when the Western Railway Loop had yet to be built, and it was that very opportunity that placed him at the Freeport VII accident and changed the course of his life. What is it, in the end, that has kept him going all this way? And what is it that he truly seeks?

records.getCharacter: I am Eliade, of Anita. Any question within my competence, I'll gladly answer.

This machine is equipped with a super thermal ion engine, allowing it to easily perform various magical sword techniques.\n——The above content appeared inexplicably in the Box database as "machine information." Based on its performance during its appearance, it is estimated that its actual combat power could even rival the mechanical tank lineup of the former N.A..

ResumeList.des: A mysterious girl claiming to be Pope of the Mechanical Vatican. Following the guarantee and certification of the conductor of CBCRR23 and the conductor's assistant, she has been provisionally classified as a special individual originating from another world. She was first discovered in the area surrounding Atricrypta Village (provisional designation), in a state of severe Morphic Field rejection, having even begun to exhibit physical dissociation. After a series of events, the individual's Morphic Field has since stabilized. At present, with the individual's own consent, she is provisionally registered as an escort crew member of the Eternal.

records.getCharacter: I am the Mechanical God who walks among mortals! Bow down before my power!

records.safeInformation: This terrifying monster has a notorious legend of devouring its pilots. Some suspect this is an exaggerated way of saying the cockpit won't open. A certain Outlander showed an incredible desire for this machine.
records.unitInformation: This terrifying monster has a notorious legend of devouring its pilot. Some suspect this is an exaggerated way of saying the cockpit can't be opened.\n——The above content is mysteriously found in the "machine information" in the Box database. Based on its performance in actual combat when it appeared, its estimated actual combat power might even rival the mechanical tank lineup of the former N.A.; however, a certain Outlander showed an incredible desire for this machine...\n"Mortals! I will claim that machine and show you the true strength of its rightful owner! Of course, you'll be fighting alongside me, won't you?"

records.safeInformation: A formidable Deep Sleeper bearing a striking resemblance to a legendary swordsman from the Empire's lore. This entity formulates strategies based on the quantity of Red and Blue hand cards. Its sword waves can deal massive damage and inflict debuffs.
records.unitInformation: This formidable Deep Sleeper, with most of its body tissues mutated, bears a resemblance to a long-haired warrior from the legends of the Mundus Empire. In the conclusion of the legend, the warrior, having lost everything, self-exiled from the homeland.\nAt the start of battle, it examines the number of in your hand, the deck and the discard pile and adjust stance accordingly. If there are more Red cards, it adopts a defensive stance, becoming immune to crowd-control effects and taking less damage. In addition, Red cards have their cost reduced when drawn, while other cards have their cost increased. If there are more Blue cards, it adopts an offensive stance and deals more damage. In addition, Blue cards have their cost reduced when drawn, while other cards have their cost increased. If the numbers of Red and Blue cards are equal or at 0, it adopts a balanced stance. In this case, its attacks deal additional True DMG, and all cards have their cost randomized when drawn.\nIt unleashes potent sword waves and inflicts various debuffs including [Scorch] and [Slash].

ResumeList.des: A mysterious mage from the Mundus Empire, said to be traveling for the time being; she is also a seasoned, deep-pocketed investor in her own right, owner of a gem shop and any number of other ventures too numerous to count. During the exchanges with the mysterious race dwelling in what's tentatively called Atricrypta Village, she offered guidance and help to the crew of The Eternal and a certain mysterious outlander. After going through a string of events alongside The Eternal's Conductor, Madam Helena chose of her own accord to register as a crew member of The Eternal.

records.getCharacter: Good day. I'm Helena, a gem mage from the Mundus Empire — here's my letter of introduction, and a little something for our first meeting. Go on, take it, no need to be so formal.

FoodList.letter: I made the noodle soup the way you like it. Next time I'll try a tomato version...

records.birthdayMessage: This is the best I could do. I hope you like it. My birthday isn't really something worth celebrating to me, but I want to say... thank you for helping me, and for being here.

ResumeList.des: Chelsea is a young scholar at the Citadel, and also one of Raziel's students — Raziel, once a fellow scholar, now a failed Angel subject. Some time ago, with Raziel's support and encouragement, Chelsea accepted a transfer to work at the Apoaster Bridge, but she's been despondent ever since; when she learned that Raziel herself had taken part in the Angel Project and failed the transformation, Chelsea fell apart completely. These events piled up on top of each other, feeding into one another, and together they became what finally drove her to change so drastically and commit the mistake that led to her trial.

records.getCharacter: Yes, I've finally been given permission to fight alongside the Eternal's crew. ...From here on, if there's anything you need done, please don't hesitate — just give me the order.

records.unitInformation: First appeared after Unbewusstes leakage incident in Haima Zaria. Scholars from Source Citadel did not follow the usual practice of naming this entity. Instead, they chose a code name from ancient tomes that means "Seas and lands are ever-changing, but all end up in ruins."\nA mysterious humanoid entity accompanied by a sword-shaped weapon, lacks communication ability but is clearly not purely inorganic. It possesses exceptionally powerful strength, capable of even altering and controlling opponents' combat strategies.

ResumeList.des: ■■■■, a former member of Anita's second department (later seconded to the fifth department), experienced significant changes in the individual Morphic Field following a series of incidents. Currently, according to their (or the individual's) wishes, this individual will henceforth be referred to by the code name "D-Ramis." Special attention is required, as this individual has developed a new self-awareness and cognition; therefore, it is necessary to respect the individual's judgments, decisions, and actions, and not to interact with them using past social methods.

records.getCharacter: Ah, we meet again... I'm so happy.

records.name: Dual Vector
records.safeInformation: An extremely powerful individual among Origin CR, capable of causing various negative effects and also causing a unique Elemental Erosion status. The Morphic Field is different from that of regular CR.
records.unitInformation: An extremely powerful individual among Origin CR, possessing different physical characteristics from other Origin CR. Like its counterparts, it belongs to the advanced life form of primitive CR, with a Morphic Field that differs from standard CR, while other traits are yet to be studied. The only known fact is that this type of CR is closely related to the Morphic Moon at its origin.\nIt can inflict various negative effects such as Curse, Wet, and Heartblaze. Additionally, it can cause a unique Elemental Erosion status, which increases specific DMG dealt by your side and reduces Healing effects you provide.

records.unitInformation: This terrifying monster has a notorious legend of devouring its pilot. Some suspect this is an exaggerated way of saying the cockpit can't be opened.\n——The above content is mysteriously found in the "machine information" in the Box database. I will claim that machine and show you the true strength of its rightful owner! Of course, you'll be fighting alongside me, won't you?"

records.name: Anethum

FoodList.letter: Here's a nutritionally balanced meal for work — eat it while it's hot!

records.birthdayMessage: I got the kids together to celebrate my birthday — you have to be there too, Conductor!

ResumeList.des: A young, dependably capable, small-statured mentor, held in high "esteem" among the interns and newcomers just joining Anita. On one hand, the newcomers trust Anethum for her painstakingly thorough explanations and care; on the other, that very same meticulous attention toward "the kids" occasionally turns her into someone people go out of their way to avoid. Beyond that, Anethum is also an accomplished young scholar in her own field, having published significant research early on, and she's now one of the leading figures pushing the civilian, portable-device rollout of Reality Stabilizer.

records.getCharacter: I know I'm still new to the Eternal... but at Anita I'm nominally your mentor, you know... so keep up the good work as always, Conductor!

records.name: Molegang Machinery
records.safeInformation: After being "retrieved" by terrorists, it was transformed into an efficient and powerful weapon. The multifunctional forearm originally used for obstacle clearing has now deviated from its original function, possessing greater lethality in combat.
records.unitInformation:
地联在篝火城计划初期为了更方便地铺设轨道而设计的大型清障工程车，在轨道上可以进行高效率作业，紧急情况下也可以脱离轨道运转，只是性能会受到影响。
在被恐怖分子们“回收”以后被改造成了高效且强力的兵器，原本用于清障的多功能前臂现在已脱离了原本的功能，在战斗方面具备了更大的杀伤性。

ResumeList.des: 年纪尚小的奉星使，在来到篝火城后因为畏惧与人沟通而一度流落街头，但因在意外中展现出不俗的战斗能力而受到萃境联盟关注。经一番波折后与科伦巴商会达成信赖与合作关系，被确认为来自不同世界的“异乡来客”，出现轻度的形态场排斥现象，但在服用原质之果以后形态场趋于稳定。经由本人同意后，现于西大陆铁路环线一带以科伦巴商会实习生身份活动。

records.getCharacter: 我、我是奉星使，嘉尔……您好，那个……抱歉，我只是有点，紧张……请您相信我的奇迹……

records.unitInformation: A large Chaos Remain known as the Bone Dragon, although it is not directly related to actual dragons. Unlike other subspecies, this particular Bone Dragon boasts a unique purplish-red hue. In folklore in certain regions, it is rumored to sustain itself on human flesh and blood.\nThis creature can inflict various debuffs including [Fetter], [Frenzy], and [Imprison]. Its attacks discard your cards, and its abilities modify the Cost of your cards. In addition, when your character is defeated or reaches low HP, it unleashes a potent AOE attack instantly.

records.name: Chaos Mantis
records.safeInformation: A Chaos Remain with an insect-like appearance, able to become invisible. Its scythe-like limbs can swiftly dismantle target defenses.
records.unitInformation: A more formidable Chaos Remain that requires at least a squad for direct engagement. With an exoskeleton resembling certain insects, its scythe-like limbs can dissolve target defenses with multi-stage attacks. It can instantly approach targets while invisible and launch powerful attacks, capable of breaking through front lines in an instant. It's a highly threatening enemy.

records.name: Chaos Gerris
records.safeInformation: A complexly structured Chaos Remain, possessing multiple attack methods. When threatened, it burrows into the ground to recover health and summons small clusters of bombardier beetles, launching self-destructive attacks at targets.
records.unitInformation: A more formidable Chaos Remain that requires at least a squad for direct engagement. With its complex armor and body structure, it employs various attack methods. When enraged, it enters a berserk state, greatly increasing its speed. It restores health by burrowing into the ground and summons small clusters of bombardier beetles underground, launching highly dangerous self-destructive attacks at targets.

records.idCN: 01敌方/02桦树/山野/昏恶渡鸦/BOSS-昏恶渡鸦
records.name: Chaos Raven
records.safeInformation: An avian-like Chaos Remain with an expandable head exoskeleton. It inflicts Reverengy DMG on targets within the area after charging.
records.unitInformation: Named "Raven" due to its avian-like nature, this Chaos Remain has luminescent head exoskeleton. While most of its attacks pose minor threats, it can inflict Reverengy DMG on a large area of enemies after prolonged charging. When it's suspended in the air, its charging status must be closely monitored.

records.idCN: 01敌方/02桦树/山野/混厄枸骨/BOSS-混厄枸骨
records.name: Chaos Citrus
records.safeInformation: A Chaos Remain resembling a plant. Its exoskeleton can converge to form a shield for protection. After charging, it can release telekinetic attacks that ripple outwards.
records.unitInformation: A more formidable Chaos Remain that requires at least a squad for direct engagement. Resembling certain plant species, its attacks typically inflict psychic damage and can drive petals to converge in front of itself as a defensive measure. After charging, it releases telekinetic attacks that ripple outwards, affecting targets within its range.

records.identity: 曼杜斯帝国·骑士屋成员

ResumeList.des: 无论你是从夏洛蒂口中听说过她，还是经由骑士屋以及萃境联盟的事务与她本人结识，蒂丝塔尔的表现都绝对不会让你失望。她的工作范围之广令人震惊，上到战斗护卫、下到洗涤打扫，无论大事小事她都能处理得井井有条——不过，从她独处时常常露出的可爱微笑来看，这位少女心中的某个角落，是否也藏着一些隐秘的心事呢？

records.getCharacter: 前随从骑士、现骑士屋的成员，蒂丝塔尔向您报道。请允许我和夏洛蒂前辈一同战斗！啊，对了，我还可以替您整理内务，您需要时请直接叫我。

records.safeInformation: A Deep Sleeper clad in Anita's uniform, whose attacks can deal Physical or Reverengy DMG. Some attacks may cause a Slash effect.
records.unitInformation: Clad in Anita Energy Tech uniform, this Deep Sleeper may have once been an explorer of the Chaos Space. Wielding a simple yet practical hand axe, he sometimes launches spinning attacks to cause Reverengy DMG to targets within a certain range. He seems capable of tossing the axe into the air and using it to slash the ground.

Crusher Skeleton
records.safeInformation: This CR: Marine, categorized as a variant of bone dragons, releases powerful ice attacks. It inflicts a variety of negative effects including Chill, Fetter, and Stun, and it releases Dragon Might that reduces incoming DMG taken. Additionally, it summons glaciers that strike multiple targets simultaneously. Its frequent and powerful attacks make it a formidable opponent.
records.unitInformation: A variant of Glacial Skeleton, originating from an unknown source. Some scholars propose that it split from a single Glacial Skeleton, while others argue that it is a chimera formed by multiple dragons attempting to devour each other.\nIt inflicts a variety of negative effects including Chill, Fetter, and Imprison, and it releases Dragon Might that reduces incoming DMG taken. Additionally, it summons glaciers that strike multiple targets simultaneously and may Chill them, and its powerful attacks can shatter the target's shield. Compared to regular bone dragons, this variant exhibits a higher frequency of attacks, thus making it a more formidable enemy.

records.safeInformation: This CR: Marine releases powerful frost attacks. It inflicts a variety of debuffs including Chill, Fetter, and Stun, and it releases "Dragon Might" that reduces DMG taken. It summons glaciers that strike multiple targets simultaneously.
records.unitInformation: This large-sized Chaos Remain showcases an exoskeleton resembling a bone dragon, although it is not related to actual "dragons" at all. It possesses the unique ability to conjure phantoms resembling its own form, while its resonating chamber produces resounding roars that reverberate through the sky. In the face of this creature, one can understand why it earns the moniker "dragon," as its breath and power rival those found in fictional tales.\nIt inflicts a variety of debuffs including [Chill], [Fetter], and [Imprison], and it casts "Dragon Might" that reduces DMG taken. Additionally, it summons glaciers that strike multiple targets simultaneously and has a chance to inflict [Chill], and its powerful attacks can shatter the target's [Shield].

FoodList.letter: 买饭的时候顺便给你带了一份，记得早点吃。

records.birthdayMessage: 虽然已经对童年没什么好印象了，但我现在希望能和重视的人一起度过生日。有空的话，晚上大家聚在一起吃顿饭、切个蛋糕吧。

ResumeList.des: 缺乏面部表情的女性，铁盟哨站的总负责人。作为镇守离修格里城最近的重要据点之人，她的指挥能力和作战能力都是无可置疑的；同时，在铁面无私的工作态度之外，她对下属和同伴的态度也是柔中带刚、恩威并济。在这样的前提下，她被称作“大姐头”也是理所当然的……等等，你说她真的当过大姐头是什么意思？

records.getCharacter: 以我们之间的信赖关系，应该不用我再自我介绍……这个流程必须要走？好吧。我是拉妲，铁盟哨站的负责人，接下来将与你并肩作战。。

FoodList.letter: 于吾之业火中轮转的尘世之饵——只焦了一点，可以吃的！

records.birthdayMessage: 黑铁之主，汝在旅途中予吾的陪伴已证明汝之真心。安心品尝吧，此为咒魔剑姬赠予、来源深渊的礼物。

ResumeList.des: 自深渊之帝国而来的咒魔剑姬已然远去。如今，身在此处的是尘世喧嚣的调停者、极乐之音的缔造者、誓约的演奏者，以及身负此上众多名号、众多罪责、众多荣光之人——且抬起头来吧，黑铁之主啊！与此人同行乃是命运赋予的责任，亦是此人心之所向！旧世界不复存在，然破晓圣光定将加护此漫漫旅途；前进吧，直到共同在业火焚尽时寻得前路！

records.getCharacter: 吾即自烈火之境归来、重获力量的卡塔斯！嘎，我们之间的契约仍然生效，这还用说？

records.name: 夏洛蒂·澄心

FoodList.letter: 我进行了艰苦的特训，这个一定可以吃了！请告诉我感想！

records.birthdayMessage: 漂亮的草莓奶油蛋糕在地表很受欢迎的样子，所以我很想和您一同尝试，每一颗草莓都是我精挑细选的。

ResumeList.des: 为了完成“骑士屋”的工作，身为管理者的夏洛蒂换上了篝火城中常见的学生制服，将大剑也掩盖在简朴的布料之下。虽然着装有所改变，但可以确认的是，她明镜般的内心不曾动摇——甚至比起过往的任何时刻都更为坚定。骑士的意志来源于守护之心，而她很清楚自己要守护什么。

records.getCharacter: 我回来了！啊，虽然这身只是为调查和城内行动而准备的便装，但您还是有点不太习惯吗……

records.idCN: 01敌方/98未知/不死鸟/BOSS-不死鸟-无转阶段
records.name: 不死鸟
records.safeInformation: 一只大家都熟悉的生物与帝国某只强大魔物相互融合的结果。它带来的火焰绝非死亡，而是热情的新生。
records.unitInformation: 地表一只并不平凡的鹅，与来自曼杜斯帝国的魔物融为一体的结果。\n流传在帝国的《曼杜斯骑士谭》中只记载了骑士们的逸闻趣事，将其与历史互相结合，但却未能表现出骑士们的性情与真心；而真正经由历史流传下来的物件，则成为了骑士后代们亟待解决的难题。这就是其中一道。\n如若能够克服这般猛烈的火焰，新的故事也必将重获生命、受人传颂吧。

records.idCN: 01敌方/09沙盗团/鸭子朱迪/BOSS-鸭子朱迪
records.name: Jude
records.safeInformation: Jude, the right-hand of Shire. More than just a cute pet, she unleashes terrifying power on the battlefield.
records.unitInformation:
被夏尔称呼为朱迪的大鹅。除了种族天赋自带的啄技外，也掌握了一些令人感叹林子大了什么鹅都会有的特殊技能——虽然主要是因为夏尔的升构能力。杀伤力比农村用来看家护院的同类还要恐怖。
尽量别惹它，也别惹它的主人。

ResumeList.des: 体型娇小但拥有不可思议力量的女性，自称是“‘天壤劫火’亚斯特尔的火雾战士——炎发灼眼的讨伐者“，最初在出现地点引发骚动，好在情形得到了及时控制。经确认为来自不同世界的”异乡来客“，出现轻度的形态场排斥现象，但在服用原质之果以后形态场趋于稳定。为了找到回去的方法，目前与无垠号乘组一起行动。

records.getCharacter: 我是“天壤劫火”亚拉斯特尔的火雾战士——炎发灼眼的讨伐者，夏娜。

records.unitInformation: 地表一只并不平凡的鹅，与来自曼杜斯帝国的魔物融为一体的结果。\n流传在帝国的《曼杜斯骑士谭》中只记载了骑士们的逸闻趣事，将其与历史互相结合，但却未能表现出骑士们的性情与真心；而真正经由历史流传下来的物件，则成为了骑士后代们亟待解决的难题。这就是其中一道。\n如若能够克服这般猛烈的火焰，新的故事也必将重获生命、受人传颂吧。

ResumeList.des: 露比，阿妮塔能源的员工，作为签署了特殊合作合同的护卫乘员登上无垠号。在对外公开的各个部门职员名单上，很难找到露比的名字——就和她尚未公开发布的研发品一样，似乎对于阿妮塔来说，她与她的技术都是需要隐藏的存在。而如果用这些事去问露比本人，却多半只能得到亮晶晶的笑容和公式化的回答。她身上或许的确存在灰色的一面，但那也只能在爆炸的烟尘散尽以后，才能得到解答了。

records.getCharacter: 你好~我是露比~阿妮塔特别派来的武器技术员哦。需要检修车载火炮？可以呀，我去看看。

records.name: Counter-Risk Unit: Enni
records.safeInformation: A large-sized countermeasure machine devised by the Destroyer of Citadel, codename "Enni." It can inflict various debuffs on its enemies and gains a damage reduction bonus whenever it takes Physical DMG. In addition, it periodically removes all buffs from your characters.
records.unitInformation: A large-sized countermeasure machine devised by the Destroyer of Citadel, codename "Enni." Its actions are controlled by a capsule-shaped countermeasure system located at the rear upper part and can receive remote commands.\nEquipped with various special weapons, it can inflict multiple negative effects, including [Knockback], [Imprison], [Fetter], and [Confuse]. It can also deal significant DMG to all allies through its flame jet device. Each time it receives Physical DMG, the amount of all DMG it takes is reduced. Once DMG reduction hits the limit, it will forcibly discard all Red cards from your hand and reset the DMG reduction effect. Additionally, it clears all allies' buffs at regular intervals.

ResumeList.des: 踏枝山庄少庄主，代其长姊■■主理■■事务。性格活泼可爱，亦属天资聪颖，自幼便广受师长喜爱；与虎跃堂镖局少主自幼交好，二人交游广泛，在武林亦为一段佳话。如今二人各自已至适婚年纪，虎跃堂少主已主动提起儿时戏言、重缔婚约，以大婚仪式，镇■■■■■。自■■■■后已■年，■■■■■■……（其后文字模糊无法辨认。）

records.getCharacter: 官人，又见面了，你可叫我好等……喂。这幅表情是什么意思，不欢迎我吗？

ResumeList.des: 年轻的铁盟通讯兵，天资聪颖，但也以其特有的作风在铁盟内享有两种极端的名声。部分铁盟成员认为以她的年纪来说她过于独断、独行，而另一部分成员则认为她年纪轻轻便能有此风范是日后能成大才的证明。然而，当你真正面对这个铁盟乘员的时候，总是会被她明亮的眼睛和背后的巨大背包所吸引——对她而言，这样的生活，又意味着什么呢？

records.getCharacter: 叫我美琪就好。虽然还不是非常熟悉，但以后就要一起工作了……呼，希望能和你成为关系不错的同伴呢。

records.safeInformation: 性质特殊的桦树生物，名为“云螭”。寻此螭影，可见龙君。
records.unitInformation: 性质特殊的桦树生物，按照踏枝山庄某本笔记残卷的记载，为其定名“云螭”。\n同样依据残卷中的记录可知，此类桦树生物并非自然产生，而是受到另一强大桦树生物的影响而扭曲、衍生的小型桦树生物。其危害虽不及使其产生的强大桦树生物本身，但仍具有相当威力。笔记最末以小字记叙，“寻此螭影，可见龙君”。

records.unitInformation: A large Chaos Remain known as the Bone Dragon, although it is not directly related to actual dragons. records.name: Slayer: Chainsaw
records.safeInformation: Leader of Slayers possessing Ascension Abilities. He deals Physical DMG and area Reverb DMG. In addition, he inflicts [Crack] on your cards, causing the user to suffer damage. This effect can be nullified by using [Crack] cards.
records.unitInformation:
One of the Slayer's leaders, clad in armor fashioned from rugby protective gear, stands tall with a faceplate concealing his visage... Could he have fallen to morphic field pollution?
Most of his attacks deal Physical DMG. His Ascension Ability enables him to deal Reverb DMG within a large area and [Stuns] his targets.
Whenever a card enters your deck, he inflicts a stack of [Crack] on it, stacking up to 3 times. Whenever a card with [Crack] is drawn, it deals DMG to the card owner based on the [Crack] stacks. Using a card with [Crack] removes a stack.
After the [Crack] effect deals DMG 30 times, he immediately unleashes his Ultimate skill, dealing Physical DMG to all enemies once and inflicting [Slash]. In addition, triggers all [Crack] effects on all of your cards.
Upon taking lethal DMG for the first time, he becomes [Invincible] for 10 seconds. After that, each time he deals DMG, he restores a large amount of HP. This effect lasts the rest of the battle.

records.safeInformation: A large-sized countermeasure machine devised by the Destroyer of Citadel, codename "Enni." It can inflict various debuffs on its enemies and gains a damage reduction bonus whenever it takes Physical DMG. In addition, it periodically removes all buffs from your characters.
records.unitInformation: A large-sized countermeasure machine devised by the Destroyer of Citadel, codename "Enni." Its actions are controlled by a capsule-shaped countermeasure system located at the rear upper part and can receive remote commands.\nEquipped with various special weapons, it can inflict multiple negative effects, including [Knockback], [Imprison], [Fetter], and [Confuse]. It can also deal significant DMG to all allies through its flame jet device. Each time it receives Physical DMG, the amount of all DMG it takes is reduced. Once DMG reduction hits the limit, it will forcibly discard all Red cards from your hand and reset the DMG reduction effect. Additionally, it clears all allies' buffs at regular intervals.

records.idCN: 01敌方/02桦树/始源/云螭/BOSS-云螭-不死
records.name: 云螭
records.safeInformation: 性质特殊的桦树生物，名为“云螭”。寻此螭影，可见龙君。
records.unitInformation: 性质特殊的桦树生物，按照踏枝山庄某本笔记残卷的记载，为其定名“云螭”。\n同样依据残卷中的记录可知，此类桦树生物并非自然产生，而是受到另一强大桦树生物的影响而扭曲、衍生的小型桦树生物。其危害虽不及使其产生的强大桦树生物本身，但仍具有相当威力。笔记最末以小字记叙，“寻此螭影，可见龙君”。

records.idCN: 00我方/09召唤物/伊洛娜·暮光/发条列车长
records.name: 发条列车长
Dual Vector
records.safeInformation: An extremely powerful individual among Origin CR, capable of causing various negative effects and also causing a unique Elemental Erosion status. The Morphic Field is different from that of regular CR.
records.unitInformation: An extremely powerful individual among Origin CR, possessing different physical characteristics from other Origin CR. Like its counterparts, it belongs to the advanced life form of primitive CR, with a Morphic Field that differs from standard CR, while other traits are yet to be studied. The only known fact is that this type of CR is closely related to the Morphic Moon at its origin.\nIt can inflict various negative effects such as Curse, Wet, and Heartblaze. Additionally, it can cause a unique Elemental Erosion status, which increases specific DMG dealt by your side and reduces Healing effects you provide.

records.name: Vortex Eye
records.safeInformation: Can inflict a variety of elemental attributes and DMG, prioritizing attacks with attributes different from the negative effects on the character. The Morphic Field differs from the general CR, and it can reduce the DMG received to a certain extent.
records.unitInformation: The CR with a powerful threat, an advanced life form of Origin CR, has a Morphic Field different from that of general CRs. Other characteristics are yet to be studied—currently, the only known fact is that this type of CR is closely related to its origin on the Morphic Moon; however, according to other research reports, it seems the Empire also has legends about similar "monsters"...\nThe Vortex Eye can target the enemy's weaknesses and even increase corresponding attribute output when it receives certain attribute DMG. Thanks to this characteristic, it poses a great threat to squads, enough to destroy an entire team in an instant.

ResumeList.des: 年纪尚小的奉星使，在来到篝火城后因为畏惧与人沟通而一度流落街头，但因在意外中展现出不俗的战斗能力而受到萃境联盟关注。经一番波折后与科伦巴商会达成信赖与合作关系，被确认为来自不同世界的“异乡来客”，出现轻度的形态场排斥现象，但在服用原质之果以后形态场趋于稳定。经由本人同意后，现于西大陆铁路环线一带以科伦巴商会实习生身份活动。

records.getCharacter: 我、我是奉星使，嘉尔……您好，那个……抱歉，我只是有点，紧张……请您相信我的奇迹……

records.idCN: 深渊/52期/荒原王·穿击动力甲-1
records.name: Wilderness King: Power Driller
records.safeInformation: Tom the Wilderness King's vehicle. Uses the recharge armored firearms to shoot and stun the target, and after breaking your character's shield, uses a drill attack to inflict an injure effect.
records.unitInformation: A versatile mecha left over from the Earth Union era, its design and manufacturing styles reflect the characteristics of that time. While the B.C.R.L. has become the dominant power, some power mechas are still in use, while others have been abandoned or resold for various reasons. One such power mecha fell into the hands of an ambitious marauder, who gave it a fancy name "The Wilderness King." However, this document refers to it as the "Power Driller."\nIt is equipped with powerful firearms that launch charged attacks, striking and stunning the target. Additionally, it can unleash drill attacks after breaking any crew member's shield, dealing DMG to the target and inflicting Injure.

records.name: Boss-泽维
不死鸟
records.safeInformation: 一只大家都熟悉的生物与帝国某只强大魔物相互融合的结果。它带来的火焰绝非死亡，而是热情的新生。
records.unitInformation: 地表一只并不平凡的鹅，与来自曼杜斯帝国的魔物融为一体的结果。\n流传在帝国的《曼杜斯骑士谭》中只记载了骑士们的逸闻趣事，将其与历史互相结合，但却未能表现出骑士们的性情与真心；而真正经由历史流传下来的物件，则成为了骑士后代们亟待解决的难题。这就是其中一道。\n如若能够克服这般猛烈的火焰，新的故事也必将重获生命、受人传颂吧。

records.name: Shire
records.safeInformation: A member of the P.U.S. named Shire, who is completely different from her appearance, a very formidable Ascender. The big goose that never leaves her side is her good partner.
records.unitInformation:
体型、外表乃至嗓音都会让人觉得“只不过是个孩子”的升构者，沙盗团成员。使用与外形完全不符的霰弹枪进行战斗，有许多人会被第一印象蒙骗，认为那不过是玩具而已。将她视为“可爱的孩子”而降低戒心的行为是十分危险的，轻视她的人通常会被教训得很惨。
经常被目击到和随身携带的鹅对话，据说是真的在进行沟通。

Molegang Machinery
records.safeInformation: After being "retrieved" by terrorists, it was transformed into an efficient and powerful weapon. The multifunctional forearm originally used for obstacle clearing has now deviated from its original function, possessing greater lethality in combat.
records.unitInformation:
地联在篝火城计划初期为了更方便地铺设轨道而设计的大型清障工程车，在轨道上可以进行高效率作业，紧急情况下也可以脱离轨道运转，只是性能会受到影响。
在被恐怖分子们“回收”以后被改造成了高效且强力的兵器，原本用于清障的多功能前臂现在已脱离了原本的功能，在战斗方面具备了更大的杀伤性。

records.name: Scorpion
records.safeInformation: The cold, austere markings, formidable armaments, and exceptional structural stability indicate that the armor before you must have served in the ranks of the N.A..
records.unitInformation:
无论从时代还是环境角度考虑都不应该出现在此地的战车。
冷冽简洁的涂饰、破坏力极强的武装，以及极高的结构稳定性，这些特征揭示了眼前这辆战车应该是曾经服役于“北方阵线”的型号。在“北阵”解散多年后的现在，北方阵线的机械现身于此的原因，还是个谜。

FoodList.letter: 我改良了从前的做法试着做了新的口味，列车长请吃！

records.birthdayMessage: 这个是拜托常去店铺的老板做的，虽然不够“成熟”，但也是一样的美味哦！

ResumeList.des: 作为御敌枢纽近年崭露头角的年轻成员之一，菲妮娅正以她自己的方式获得越来越多的成绩和认可。在经历不少事件的磨炼后，菲妮娅锻炼出了更为强大的战斗能力，然而，随之而来的是一场众人始料未及的意外——“二次升构”。如今站在我们面前的这位少女，则是克服了这场意外后，更为闪耀、自信，勇于不断向远方闪耀着的理想伸出手的，如今的菲妮娅。

records.getCharacter: 我是菲妮娅！咳嗯，列车长肯定能认出来我啦，这种自我介绍肯定也是多余的——哎？！认不出来了？！开玩笑的吧！

records.name: Nether Envoy
records.safeInformation: An immensely powerful Primal Chaos Remain capable of altering the battlefield environment. Nether Envoy can switch between Darkness Ritual and Radiance Ritual, inflicting different damage types and debuffs accordingly.
records.unitInformation: An immensely powerful Primal Chaos entity featuring a towering form. Upon its arrival, dark clouds envelop the sky, leading to localized weather changes, although its exact purpose remains a mystery.\nThe Nether Envoy can manipulate the battlefield environment, adjusting its abilities and damage types accordingly. While in the Radiance Ritual environment, it deals Electro DMG and increases the card costs in your hand. While in the Darkness Ritual environment, it deals Reverengy DMG, reduces the card costs in your hand, and heals your characters. In addition, it possesses skills that reduce Final DMG taken, and when afflicted by debuffs, it sacrifices its HP to nullify them. Please note that its skills inflict various debuffs and deal massive damage to all your characters.

records.name: Vortex Eye
records.safeInformation: Can inflict a variety of elemental attributes and DMG, prioritizing attacks with attributes different from the negative effects on the character. The Morphic Field differs from the general CR, and it can reduce the DMG received to a certain extent.
records.unitInformation: The CR with a powerful threat, an advanced life form of Origin CR, has a Morphic Field different from that of general CRs. Other characteristics are yet to be studied—currently, the only known fact is that this type of CR is closely related to its origin on the Morphic Moon; however, according to other research reports, it seems the Empire also has legends about similar "monsters"...\nThe Vortex Eye can target the enemy's weaknesses and even increase corresponding attribute output when it receives certain attribute DMG. Thanks to this characteristic, it poses a great threat to squads, enough to destroy an entire team in an instant.

ResumeList.des: 你的同级生、同班同学，可爱的年轻女孩，寄宿家庭的独女，亚莉奈。她对你的关心和照顾无微不至，稍加观察就会发现，她总是和你的生活轨迹保持同步——一起上学、一起放学，为你准备便当、熨烫制服，解答你的每个问题，回应你的每个请求。最近她似乎对调饮产生了兴趣，开始总把各种饮品和无酒精鸡尾酒的事挂在嘴边；每次她提到相关的事时，总是万分期待地看着你。这一定是因为她非常、非常需要你的建议，对吧？

records.name: Chaos Behemoth
records.safeInformation: This entity deals both melee Physical DMG and area Reverb DMG. It also curses its enemies and shatters their shields. Keep in mind that it deals increased Reverb DMG as its HP decreases.
records.unitInformation: A towering Chaos Remain prone to sudden fits of rage. Its intricately armored exterior boasts exceptional strength. Even in a calm state, its strikes and stomps are formidable, posing significant threats. When enraged, it becomes even deadlier, unleashing devastating attacks. The horn on its head can harness reverberation energies to afflict various debuffs on the target or even render them unconscious.

records.name: Chaos Ganoderma
records.safeInformation: A highly formidable individual among Wilds CR, capable of influencing human minds and inflicting effects such as [Scorch] and [Berserk]. Its armor provides defense and can rebound attacks. Extra caution is required when it enters a defensive stance.
records.unitInformation: A grotesquely shaped Chaos Remain that possesses the ability to reflect incoming damage, owing to its makeshift armor. While naming this formidable creature, researchers encountered some controversy regarding the naming rules for Chaos Remains...\nIts attacks inflict various negative effects including [Slash], [Scorch], and [Interrupt]. Its skill [Rampant Ripples] deals Reverengy DMG while inflicting [Berserk] or [Confuse], and drains energy from crew members based on the number of crew members under [Berserk] effect. It can assume a defensive stance by curling up. While in this state, whenever it takes a certain number of hits, it gains a stack of Fury, reducing its DEF and increasing its ATK. When it accumulates a certain number of Fury stacks or when its defensive stance expires, it deals Reverengy DMG to all crew members based on the Fury stacks and inflicts [Injure].

records.unitInformation:

records.unitInformation: Clad in Anita Energy Tech uniform, this Deep Sleeper may have once been an explorer of the Chaos Space. He seems capable of tossing the axe into the air and using it to slash the ground.

records.name: Ancestor's Retribution
records.safeInformation: A formidable Deep Sleeper bearing a striking resemblance to a legendary swordsman from the Empire's lore. This entity formulates strategies based on the quantity of Red and Blue hand cards. Its sword waves can deal massive damage and inflict debuffs.
records.unitInformation: This formidable Deep Sleeper, with most of its body tissues mutated, bears a resemblance to a long-haired warrior from the legends of the Mundus Empire. In the conclusion of the legend, the warrior, having lost everything, self-exiled from the homeland.\nAt the start of battle, it examines the number of in your hand, the deck and the discard pile and adjust stance accordingly. If there are more Red cards, it adopts a defensive stance, becoming immune to crowd-control effects and taking less damage. In addition, Red cards have their cost reduced when drawn, while other cards have their cost increased. If there are more Blue cards, it adopts an offensive stance and deals more damage. In addition, Blue cards have their cost reduced when drawn, while other cards have their cost increased. If the numbers of Red and Blue cards are equal or at 0, it adopts a balanced stance. In this case, its attacks deal additional True DMG, and all cards have their cost randomized when drawn.\nIt unleashes potent sword waves and inflicts various debuffs including [Scorch] and [Slash].

records.unitInformation: Often found in areas heavily polluted by morphic fields, this Deep Sleeper has regenerated body parts into dagger-like forms. He can swiftly slash targets with flaming daggers, inflicting significant Fire DMG on a single target and causing a Flare effect.

records.idCN: 深渊/60期/第四层召唤/下半/深眠者·迷踪
records.name: DS: Lost
records.safeInformation: A Deep Sleeper often found in areas heavily polluted by morphic fields, able to deal Electro DMG to weapons and block incoming attacks. His counterattacks during blocking can imprison targets within the area.
records.unitInformation: Often found in areas heavily polluted by morphic fields, this Deep Sleeper can apply sustainable Electro DMG to weapons and use them to block attacks. The DMG taken during blocking enhances his counterattack, which inflicts Electro DMG and can imprison targets within the area.

records.idCN: 深渊/60期/第四层召唤/下半/深眠者·迷离
records.name: DS: Dazed
records.safeInformation: A Deep Sleeper often found in areas heavily polluted by morphic fields, able to launch frost attacks and inflict a Chill effect. Also has the ability to restore health and reduce DMG taken by other enemies.
records.unitInformation: Often found in areas heavily polluted by morphic fields, this Deep Sleeper remains dedicated to aiding her companions despite her altered appearance. Her attacks typically inflict Frost DMG and apply a Chill effect. Additionally, she can restore health to other Deep Sleepers and use force fields to reduce DMG taken by her companions.

records.idCN: 深渊/60期/第四层召唤/下半/深眠者·迷惘
records.name: DS: Confused
records.safeInformation: A Deep Sleeper often found in areas heavily polluted by morphic fields, able to launch arcane attacks and imprison targets within a certain range.
records.unitInformation: Often found in areas heavily polluted by morphic fields, this Deep Sleeper retains a human appearance but has deteriorated internally, especially his hands. Primarily uses arcane attacks to damage targets from a distance and can imprison targets within a certain range.

records.idCN: 深渊/60期/第四层召唤/下半/深眠者·迷痴
records.name: DS: Bewitched
records.safeInformation: A Deep Sleeper clad in Anita's uniform, who can cause Reverengy DMG after charging up its defense. He can also heal himself and dispel his own negative effects.
records.unitInformation: Clad in Anita Energy Tech uniform, this Deep Sleeper may have once been an explorer of the chaos space. Wielding a heavy shield and hammer, he boasts excellent defense and healing abilities. The bandage-like tissue wrapped around his body seems to be the main conduit for his healing abilities, so his status should be monitored closely.

records.idCN: 深渊/60期/第四层召唤/下半/深眠者·迷愚
records.name: DS: Bewildered
records.safeInformation: A Deep Sleeper clad in Anita's uniform, whose attacks can deal Physical or Reverengy DMG. Some attacks may cause a Slash effect.
records.unitInformation: Clad in Anita Energy Tech uniform, this Deep Sleeper may have once been an explorer of the Chaos Space. Wielding a simple yet practical hand axe, he sometimes launches spinning attacks to cause Reverengy DMG to targets within a certain range. He seems capable of tossing the axe into the air and using it to slash the ground.
